name: proposition_6
statement:
theorem proposition_6 : ∀ (a b c : Point) (AB BC AC : Line),
  formTriangle a b c AB BC AC ∧ (∠ a:b:c = ∠ a:c:b) →
  |(a─b)| = |(a─c)|

name: proposition_47
statement:
theorem proposition_47 : ∀ (a b c: Point) (AB BC AC : Line),
  formTriangle a b c AB BC AC ∧ (∠ b:a:c : ℝ) = ∟ →
  |(b─c)| * |(b─c)| = |(b─a)| * |(b─a)| + |(a─c)| * |(a─c)|

name: proposition_10
statement:
theorem proposition_10 : ∀ (a b : Point) (AB : Line), distinctPointsOnLine a b AB →
  ∃ d : Point, (between a d b) ∧ (|(a─d)| = |(d─b)|)

name: proposition_30
statement:
theorem proposition_30 : ∀ (AB CD EF : Line),
  AB ≠ CD ∧ CD ≠ EF ∧ EF ≠ AB ∧ ¬(AB.intersectsLine EF) ∧ ¬(CD.intersectsLine EF) →
  ¬(AB.intersectsLine CD)

name: proposition_26
statement:
theorem proposition_26 : ∀ (a b c d e f : Point) (AB BC AC DE EF DF : Line),
  formTriangle a b c AB BC AC ∧ formTriangle d e f DE EF DF ∧
  (∠ a:b:c = ∠ d:e:f) ∧ (∠ b:c:a = ∠ e:f:d) ∧ (|(b─c)| = |(e─f)| ∨ |(a─b)| = |(d─e)|) →
  (|(a─b)| = |(d─e)|) ∧ (|(b─c)| = |(e─f)|) ∧ (|(a─c)| = |(d─f)|) ∧ (∠ b:a:c = ∠ e:d:f)

name: proposition_27
statement:
theorem proposition_27 : ∀ (a d e f : Point) (AE FD EF : Line),
  distinctPointsOnLine a e AE ∧ distinctPointsOnLine f d FD ∧ distinctPointsOnLine e f EF ∧
  a.opposingSides d EF ∧ (∠ a:e:f = ∠ e:f:d) →
  ¬(AE.intersectsLine FD)

name: proposition_31
statement:
theorem proposition_31 : ∀ (a b c : Point) (BC : Line),
  distinctPointsOnLine b c BC ∧ ¬(a.onLine BC) →
  ∃ EF : Line, a.onLine EF ∧ ¬(EF.intersectsLine BC)

name: proposition_11
statement:
theorem proposition_11 : ∀ (a b c : Point) (AB : Line),
  distinctPointsOnLine a b AB ∧ between a c b →
  exists f : Point, ¬(f.onLine AB) ∧ (∠ a:c:f = ∟)

name: proposition_11'
statement:
theorem proposition_11' : ∀ (a b c x : Point) (AB : Line),
  (distinctPointsOnLine a b AB) ∧ (between a c b) ∧ ¬(x.onLine AB) →
  exists f : Point, (f.sameSide x AB) ∧ (∠ a:c:f = ∟)

name: proposition_11''
statement:
theorem proposition_11'' : ∀ (a b : Point) (AB : Line),
  distinctPointsOnLine a b AB →
  exists (f : Point), ¬(f.onLine AB) ∧ (∠ f:a:b = ∟)

name: proposition_11'''
statement:
theorem proposition_11''' : ∀ (a b x : Point) (AB : Line),
  ¬(x.onLine AB) ∧ (distinctPointsOnLine a b AB) →
  exists (f : Point), ¬(f.onLine AB) ∧ (f.opposingSides x AB) ∧ (∠ f:a:b = ∟)

name: proposition_46
statement:
theorem proposition_46 : ∀ (a b : Point) (AB : Line), distinctPointsOnLine a b AB →
  ∃ (d e : Point) (DE AD BE : Line), formParallelogram d e a b DE AB AD BE ∧
  |(d─e)| = |(a─b)| ∧ |(a─d)| = |(a─b)| ∧ |(b─e)| = |(a─b)| ∧
  (∠ b:a:d = ∟) ∧ (∠ a:d:e = ∟) ∧ (∠ a:b:e = ∟) ∧ (∠ b:e:d = ∟)

name: proposition_46'
statement:
theorem proposition_46' : ∀ (a b x : Point) (AB : Line), ¬(x.onLine AB) ∧ distinctPointsOnLine a b AB →
  ∃ (d e : Point) (DE AD BE : Line), d.opposingSides x AB ∧ formParallelogram d e a b DE AB AD BE ∧
  |(d─e)| = |(a─b)| ∧ |(a─d)| = |(a─b)| ∧ |(b─e)| = |(a─b)| ∧
  (∠ b:a:d : ℝ) = ∟ ∧ (∠ a:d:e : ℝ) = ∟ ∧ (∠ a:b:e : ℝ) = ∟ ∧ (∠ b:e:d : ℝ) = ∟

name: proposition_7
statement:
theorem proposition_7 : ∀ (a b c d : Point) (AB AC CB AD DB : Line),
  distinctPointsOnLine a b AB ∧ distinctPointsOnLine a c AC ∧ distinctPointsOnLine c b CB ∧
  distinctPointsOnLine a d AD ∧ distinctPointsOnLine d b DB ∧ (c.sameSide d AB) ∧ c ≠ d ∧
  (|(a─c)| = |(a─d)|) ∧ (|(c─b)| = |(d─b)|) → False

name: proposition_36
statement:
theorem proposition_36 : ∀ (a b c d e f g h : Point) (AH BG AB CD EF HG : Line),
  formParallelogram a d b c AH BG AB CD ∧ formParallelogram e h f g AH BG EF HG ∧
  |(b─c)| = |(f─g)| ∧ (between a d h) ∧ (between a e h) →
  triangle.area △ a:b:d + triangle.area △ d:b:c = triangle.area △ e:f:h + triangle.area △ h:f:g

name: proposition_36'
statement:
theorem proposition_36' : ∀ (a b c d e f g h : Point) (AH BG AB CD EF HG : Line) ,
  formParallelogram a d b c AH BG AB CD ∧ formParallelogram e h f g AH BG EF HG ∧
  |(b─c)| = |(f─g)| →
  triangle.area △ a:b:d + triangle.area △ d:b:c = triangle.area △ e:f:h + triangle.area △ h:f:g

name: proposition_20
statement:
theorem proposition_20 : ∀ (a b c : Point) (AB BC AC : Line),
  formTriangle a b c AB BC AC → |(b─a)| + |(a─c)| > |(b─c)|

name: proposition_41
statement:
theorem proposition_41 : ∀ (a b c d e : Point) (AE BC AB CD BE CE : Line),
  formParallelogram a d b c AE BC AB CD ∧ formTriangle e b c BE BC CE ∧ e.onLine AE ∧ ¬(AE.intersectsLine  BC) →
  (triangle.area △ a:b:c : ℝ) + (triangle.area △ a:c:d) = (triangle.area △ e:b:c) + (triangle.area △ e :b :c)

name: proposition_16
statement:
theorem proposition_16 : ∀ (a b c d : Point) (AB BC AC: Line),
  formTriangle a b c AB BC AC ∧ (between b c d) →
  (∠ a:c:d > ∠ c:b:a) ∧ (∠ a:c:d > ∠ b:a:c)

name: proposition_17
statement:
theorem proposition_17 : ∀ (a b c : Point) (AB BC AC : Line),
  formTriangle a b c AB BC AC →
  ∠ a:b:c + ∠ b:c:a < ∟ + ∟

name: proposition_40
statement:
theorem proposition_40 : ∀  (a b c d e : Point) (AB BC AC CD DE AD : Line),
  formTriangle a b c AB BC AC ∧ formTriangle d c e CD BC DE ∧ a.sameSide d BC ∧ b ≠ e ∧ |(b─c)| = |(c─e)| ∧
  distinctPointsOnLine a d AD ∧ (triangle.area △ a:b:c = triangle.area △ d:c:e) →
  ¬(AD.intersectsLine BC)

name: proposition_1
statement:
theorem proposition_1 : ∀ (a b : Point) (AB : Line),
  distinctPointsOnLine a b AB →
  ∃ c : Point, |(c─a)| = |(a─b)| ∧ |(c─b)| = |(a─b)|

name: proposition_1'
statement:
theorem proposition_1' : ∀ (a b x : Point) (AB : Line),
  distinctPointsOnLine a b AB ∧ ¬(x.onLine AB) →
  ∃ c : Point, |(c─a)| = |(a─b)| ∧ |(c─b)| = |(a─b)| ∧ (c.opposingSides x AB)

name: proposition_21
statement:
theorem proposition_21 : ∀ (a b c d : Point) (AB BC AC BD DC : Line),
  formTriangle a b c AB BC AC ∧ (a.sameSide d BC) ∧ (c.sameSide d AB) ∧ (b.sameSide d AC) ∧
  distinctPointsOnLine b d BD ∧ distinctPointsOnLine d c DC →
  (|(b─d)| + |(d─c)| < |(b─a)| + |(a─c)|) ∧ (∠ b:d:c > ∠ b:a:c)

name: proposition_37
statement:
theorem proposition_37 : ∀ (a b c d : Point) (AB BC AC BD CD AD : Line),
  formTriangle a b c AB BC AC ∧ formTriangle d b c BD BC CD ∧ distinctPointsOnLine a d AD ∧
  ¬(AD.intersectsLine BC) ∧ d.sameSide c AB →
  triangle.area △ a:b:c = triangle.area △ d:b:c

name: proposition_37'
statement:
theorem proposition_37' : ∀ (a b c d : Point) (AB BC AC BD CD AD : Line),
  formTriangle a b c AB BC AC ∧ formTriangle d b c BD BC CD ∧ distinctPointsOnLine a d AD ∧
  ¬(AD.intersectsLine BC) →
  triangle.area △ a:b:c = triangle.area △ d:b:c

name: proposition_22
statement:
theorem proposition_22 : ∀ (a a' b b' c c' : Point) (A B C : Line),
  distinctPointsOnLine a a' A ∧ distinctPointsOnLine b b' B ∧ distinctPointsOnLine c c' C ∧
  (|(a─a')| + |(b─b')| > |(c─c')|) ∧
  (|(a─a')| + |(c─c')| > |(b─b')|) ∧
  (|(b─b')| + |(c─c')| > |(a─a')|) →
  ∃ (k f g : Point), (|(f─k)| = |(a─a')|) ∧ (|(f─g)| = |(b─b')|) ∧ (|(k─g)| = |(c─c')|)

name: proposition_22'
statement:
theorem proposition_22' : ∀ (a a' b b' c c' f e : Point) (A B C FE : Line),
  distinctPointsOnLine a a' A ∧ distinctPointsOnLine b b' B ∧ distinctPointsOnLine c c' C ∧ distinctPointsOnLine f e FE ∧
  (|(a─a')| + |(b─b')| > |(c─c')|) ∧
  (|(a─a')| + |(c─c')| > |(b─b')|) ∧
  (|(b─b')| + |(c─c')| > |(a─a')|) →
  ∃ (k g : Point), g.onLine FE ∧ ¬(between g f e) ∧
  (|(f─k)| = |(a─a')|) ∧ (|(f─g)| = |(b─b')|) ∧ (|(k─g)| = |(c─c')|)

name: proposition_22''
statement:
theorem proposition_22'' : ∀ (a a' b b' c c' f e x : Point) (A B C FE : Line),
  distinctPointsOnLine a a' A ∧ distinctPointsOnLine b b' B ∧ distinctPointsOnLine c c' C ∧ distinctPointsOnLine f e FE ∧ ¬(x.onLine FE) ∧
  (|(a─a')| + |(b─b')| > |(c─c')|) ∧
  (|(a─a')| + |(c─c')| > |(b─b')|) ∧
  (|(b─b')| + |(c─c')| > |(a─a')|) →
  ∃ (k g : Point), g.onLine FE ∧ ¬(between g f e) ∧ (k.sameSide x FE) ∧
  (|(f─k)| = |(a─a')|) ∧ (|(f─g)| = |(b─b')|) ∧ (|(k─g)| = |(c─c')|)

name: proposition_34
statement:
theorem proposition_34 : ∀ (a b c d : Point) (AB CD AC BD BC : Line),
  formParallelogram a b c d AB CD AC BD ∧ distinctPointsOnLine b c BC →
  |(a─b)| = |(c─d)| ∧ |(a─c)| = |(b─d)| ∧
  ∠ a:b:d = ∠ a:c:d ∧ ∠ b:a:c  = ∠ c:d:b ∧
  triangle.area △ a:b:c = triangle.area △ d:c:b

name: proposition_34'
statement:
theorem proposition_34' : ∀ (a b c d : Point) (AB CD AC BD : Line),
  formParallelogram a b c d AB CD AC BD →
  |(a─b)| = |(c─d)| ∧ |(a─c)| = |(b─d)| ∧
  ∠ a:b:d = ∠ a:c:d ∧ ∠ b:a:c = ∠ c:d:b

name: proposition_18
statement:
theorem proposition_18 : ∀ (a b c : Point) (AB BC AC : Line),
  formTriangle a b c AB BC AC ∧ (|(a─c)| > |(a─b)|) →
  (∠ a:b:c > ∠ b:c:a)

name: proposition_38
statement:
theorem proposition_38 : ∀ (a b c d e f: Point) (AD BF AB AC DE DF : Line),
  a.onLine AD ∧ d.onLine AD ∧ formTriangle a b c AB BF AC ∧ formTriangle d e f DE BF DF ∧
  ¬(AD.intersectsLine BF) ∧ (between b c f) ∧ (between b e f) ∧ |(b─c)| = |(e─f)| →
  triangle.area △ a:b:c = triangle.area △ d:e:f

name: proposition_14
statement:
theorem proposition_14 : ∀ (a b c d : Point) (AB BC BD : Line),
  distinctPointsOnLine a b AB ∧ distinctPointsOnLine b c BC ∧ distinctPointsOnLine b d BD ∧ (c.opposingSides d AB) ∧
  (∠ a:b:c + ∠ a:b:d) = ∟ + ∟ →
  BC = BD

name: proposition_43
statement:
theorem proposition_43 : ∀ (a b c d e f g h k : Point) (AD BC AB CD AC EF GH : Line),
  formParallelogram a d b c AD BC AB CD ∧ distinctPointsOnLine a c AC ∧ k.onLine AC ∧
  between a h d ∧ formParallelogram a h e k AD EF AB GH ∧ formParallelogram k f g c EF BC GH CD →
  (triangle.area △ e:b:g + triangle.area △ e:g:k = triangle.area △ h:k:f + triangle.area △ h:f:d)

name: proposition_2
statement:
theorem proposition_2 : ∀ (a b c : Point) (BC : Line),
  (distinctPointsOnLine b c BC) ∧ (a ≠ b) →
  ∃ l : Point, |(a─l)| = |(b─c)|

name: proposition_2'
statement:
theorem proposition_2' : ∀ (a b c : Point) (BC : Line),
  distinctPointsOnLine b c BC →
  ∃ l : Point, |(a─l)| = |(b─c)|

name: proposition_3
statement:
theorem proposition_3 : ∀ (a b c₀ c₁ : Point) (AB C : Line),
  distinctPointsOnLine a b AB ∧ distinctPointsOnLine c₀ c₁ C ∧ |(a─b)| > |(c₀─c₁)| →
  ∃ e : Point, between a e b ∧ |(a─e)| = |(c₀─c₁)|

name: proposition_42
statement:
theorem proposition_42 : ∀ (a b c d₁ d₂ d₃ : Point) (AB BC AC D₁₂ D₂₃: Line),
  formTriangle a b c AB BC AC ∧ formRectilinearAngle d₁ d₂ d₃ D₁₂ D₂₃ ∧
  (∠ d₁:d₂:d₃ : ℝ) > 0 ∧ (∠ d₁:d₂:d₃ : ℝ) < ∟ + ∟ →
  ∃ (f g e c' : Point) (FG EC EF CG : Line), formParallelogram f g e c' FG EC EF CG ∧
  (∠ c':e:f = ∠ d₁:d₂:d₃) ∧ (triangle.area △ f:e:c' + triangle.area △ f:c':g = triangle.area △ a:b:c)

name: proposition_42'
statement:
theorem proposition_42' : ∀ (a b c d₁ d₂ d₃ e : Point) (AB BC AC D₁₂ D₂₃: Line),
  formTriangle a b c AB BC AC ∧ formRectilinearAngle d₁ d₂ d₃ D₁₂ D₂₃ ∧ between b e c ∧ (|(b─e)| = |(e─c)|) ∧
  (∠ d₁:d₂:d₃ : ℝ) > 0 ∧ (∠ d₁:d₂:d₃ : ℝ) < ∟ + ∟ →
  ∃ (f g : Point) (FG EF CG : Line), a.sameSide f BC ∧ formParallelogram f g e c FG BC EF CG ∧
  (∠ c:e:f : ℝ) = (∠ d₁:d₂:d₃) ∧ (triangle.area △ f:e:c : ℝ) + (triangle.area △ f:c:g) = (triangle.area △ a:b:c)

name: proposition_42''
statement:
theorem proposition_42'' : ∀ (a b c d₁ d₂ d₃ h i : Point) (AB BC AC D₁₂ D₂₃ HI : Line),
  formTriangle a b c AB BC AC ∧ formRectilinearAngle d₁ d₂ d₃ D₁₂ D₂₃ ∧
  (∠ d₁:d₂:d₃ : ℝ) > 0 ∧ (∠ d₁:d₂:d₃ : ℝ) < ∟ + ∟ ∧ distinctPointsOnLine h i HI →
  ∃ (f g j : Point) (FG FI GJ : Line), between h i j ∧ formParallelogram f g i j FG HI FI GJ ∧
  (∠ j:i:f : ℝ) = (∠ d₁:d₂:d₃) ∧ (triangle.area △ f:i:j : ℝ) + (triangle.area △ f:j:g) = (triangle.area △ a:b:c)

name: proposition_42'''
statement:
theorem proposition_42''' : ∀ (a b c d₁ d₂ d₃ h i x : Point) (AB BC AC D₁₂ D₂₃ HI : Line),
  formTriangle a b c AB BC AC ∧ formRectilinearAngle d₁ d₂ d₃ D₁₂ D₂₃ ∧ ¬(x.onLine HI) ∧
  (∠ d₁:d₂:d₃ : ℝ) > 0 ∧ (∠ d₁:d₂:d₃ : ℝ) < ∟ + ∟ ∧ distinctPointsOnLine h i HI →
  ∃ (f g j : Point) (FG FI GJ : Line), f.sameSide x HI ∧ between h i j ∧ formParallelogram f g i j FG HI FI GJ ∧
  (∠ j:i:f : ℝ) = (∠ d₁:d₂:d₃) ∧ (triangle.area △ f:i:j : ℝ) + (triangle.area △ f:j:g) = (triangle.area △ a:b:c)

name: proposition_15
statement:
theorem proposition_15 : ∀ (a b c d e : Point) (AB CD : Line),
  distinctPointsOnLine a b AB ∧ distinctPointsOnLine c d CD ∧ e.onLine AB ∧ e.onLine CD ∧
  CD ≠ AB ∧ (between d e c) ∧ (between a e b) →
  (∠ a:e:c = ∠ d:e:b) ∧ (∠ c:e:b = ∠ a:e:d)

name: proposition_39
statement:
theorem proposition_39 : ∀ (a b c d : Point) (AB BC AC BD CD AD : Line),
  formTriangle a b c AB BC AC ∧ formTriangle d b c BD BC CD ∧ a.sameSide d BC ∧
  (△ a:b:c : ℝ) = (△ d:b:c) ∧ distinctPointsOnLine a d AD →
  ¬(AD.intersectsLine BC)

name: proposition_19
statement:
theorem proposition_19 : ∀ (a b c : Point) (AB BC AC : Line),
  formTriangle a b c AB BC AC ∧ (∠ a:b:c > ∠ b:c:a) →
  (|(a─c)| > |(a─b)|)

name: proposition_35
statement:
theorem proposition_35 : ∀ (a b c d e f g : Point) (AF BC AB CD EB FC : Line),
  formParallelogram a d b c AF BC AB CD ∧ formParallelogram e f b c AF BC EB FC ∧
  between a d e ∧ between d e f ∧ g.onLine CD ∧ g.onLine EB →
  triangle.area △a:b:d + triangle.area △d:b:c = triangle.area △e:b:c + triangle.area △ e:c:f

name: proposition_35'
statement:
theorem proposition_35' : ∀ (a b c d e f : Point) (AF BC AB CD EB FC : Line),
  formParallelogram a d b c AF BC AB CD ∧ formParallelogram e f b c AF BC EB FC →
  triangle.area △a:b:d  + triangle.area △d:b:c = triangle.area △e:b:c + triangle.area △ e:c:f

name: proposition_23
statement:
theorem proposition_23 : ∀ (a b c d e : Point) (AB CD CE : Line),
  distinctPointsOnLine a b AB ∧ formRectilinearAngle d c e CD CE →
  ∃ f : Point, f ≠ a ∧ (∠ f:a:b = ∠ d:c:e)

name: proposition_23'
statement:
theorem proposition_23' : ∀ (a b c d e x : Point) (AB CD CE : Line),
  distinctPointsOnLine a b AB ∧ formRectilinearAngle d c e CD CE ∧ ¬(x.onLine AB) →
  ∃ f : Point, f ≠ a ∧ (f.onLine AB ∨ f.sameSide x AB) ∧ (∠ f:a:b = ∠ d:c:e)

name: proposition_28
statement:
theorem proposition_28 : ∀ (a b c d e f g h : Point) (AB CD EF : Line),
  distinctPointsOnLine a b AB ∧ distinctPointsOnLine c d CD ∧ distinctPointsOnLine e f EF ∧
  (between a g b) ∧ (between c h d) ∧ (between e g h) ∧ (between g h f) ∧ (b.sameSide d EF) ∧
  (∠ e:g:b = ∠ g:h:d ∨ ∠ b:g:h + ∠ g:h:d = ∟ + ∟) →
  ¬(AB.intersectsLine CD)

name: proposition_12
statement:
theorem proposition_12 : ∀ (a b c : Point) (AB : Line),
  distinctPointsOnLine a b AB ∧ ¬(c.onLine AB) →
  exists h : Point, h.onLine AB ∧ (∠ a:h:c = ∟ ∨ ∠ b:h:c = ∟)

name: proposition_12'
statement:
theorem proposition_12' : ∀ (a b c : Point) (AB : Line),
  distinctPointsOnLine a b AB ∧ ¬(c.onLine AB) →
  exists h : Point, h.onLine AB ∧ ((a ≠ h ∧ ∠ a:h:c = ∟) ∨ (b ≠ h ∧ ∠ b:h:c = ∟))

name: proposition_45
statement:
theorem proposition_45 : ∀ (a b c d e₁ e₂ e₃ : Point) (AB BC CD AD DB E₁₂ E₂₃ : Line),
  formTriangle a b d AB DB AD ∧ formTriangle b c d BC CD DB ∧ a.opposingSides c DB ∧
  formRectilinearAngle e₁ e₂ e₃ E₁₂ E₂₃ ∧ ∠ e₁:e₂:e₃ > 0 ∧ ∠ e₁:e₂:e₃ < ∟ + ∟ →
  ∃ (f l k m : Point) (FL KM FK LM : Line), formParallelogram f l k m FL KM FK LM ∧
  (∠ f:k:m = ∠ e₁:e₂:e₃) ∧ (triangle.area △ f:k:m + triangle.area △ f:l:m = triangle.area △ a:b:d + triangle.area △ d:b:c)

name: proposition_4
statement:
theorem proposition_4 : ∀ (a b c d e f : Point) (AB BC AC DE EF DF : Line),
  formTriangle a b c AB BC AC ∧ formTriangle d e f DE EF DF ∧
  |(a─b)| = |(d─e)| ∧ |(a─c)| = |(d─f)| ∧ (∠ b:a:c = ∠ e:d:f) →
  |(b─c)| = |(e─f)| ∧ (∠ a:b:c = ∠ d:e:f) ∧ (∠ a:c:b = ∠ d:f:e)

name: proposition_24
statement:
theorem proposition_24 : ∀ (a b c d e f : Point) (AB BC AC DE EF DF : Line),
  formTriangle a b c AB BC AC ∧ formTriangle d e f DE EF DF ∧
  (|(a─b)| = |(d─e)|) ∧ (|(a─c)| = |(d─f)|) ∧ (∠ b:a:c > ∠ e:d:f) →
  |(b─c)| > |(e─f)|

name: proposition_32
statement:
theorem proposition_32 : ∀ (a b c d : Point) (AB BC AC : Line),
  formTriangle a b c AB BC AC ∧ (between b c d) →
  ∠ a:c:d = ∠ c:a:b + ∠ a:b:c ∧
  ∠ a:b:c + ∠ b:c:a + ∠ c:a:b = ∟ + ∟

name: proposition_8
statement:
theorem proposition_8 : ∀ (a b c d e f : Point) (AB BC AC DE EF DF : Line),
  formTriangle a b c AB BC AC ∧ formTriangle d e f DE EF DF ∧
  |(a─b)| = |(d─e)| ∧ |(a─c)| = |(d─f)| ∧ |(b─c)| = |(e─f)| →
  ∠ b:a:c = ∠ e:d:f

name: proposition_9
statement:
theorem proposition_9 : ∀ (a b c : Point) (AB AC : Line),
  formRectilinearAngle b a c AB AC ∧ AB ≠ AC →
  ∃ f : Point, f ≠ a ∧ (∠ b:a:f = ∠ c:a:f)

name: proposition_9'
statement:
theorem proposition_9' : ∀ (a b c : Point) (AB AC : Line),
  formRectilinearAngle b a c AB AC ∧ AB ≠ AC →
  ∃ f : Point, (f.sameSide c AB) ∧ (f.sameSide b AC) ∧ (∠ b:a:f = ∠ c:a:f)

name: proposition_48
statement:
theorem proposition_48 : ∀ (a b c : Point) (AB BC AC : Line),
  formTriangle a b c AB BC AC ∧ |(b─c)| * |(b─c)| = |(b─a)| * |(b─a)| + |(a─c)| * |(a─c)| →
  ∠ b:a:c = ∟

name: proposition_33
statement:
theorem proposition_33 : ∀ (a b c d : Point) (AB CD AC BD : Line),
  distinctPointsOnLine a b AB ∧ distinctPointsOnLine c d CD ∧
  distinctPointsOnLine a c AC ∧ distinctPointsOnLine b d BD ∧
  (a.sameSide c BD) ∧ ¬(AB.intersectsLine CD) ∧ |(a─b)| = |(c─d)| →
  AC ≠ BD ∧ ¬(AC.intersectsLine BD) ∧ |(a─c)|= |(b─d)|

name: proposition_25
statement:
theorem proposition_25 : ∀ (a b c d e f : Point) (AB BC AC DE EF DF : Line),
  formTriangle a b c AB BC AC ∧ formTriangle d e f DE EF DF ∧
  (|(a─b)| = |(d─e)|) ∧ (|(a─c)| = |(d─f)|) ∧ (|(b─c)| > |(e─f)|) →
  (∠ b:a:c > ∠ e:d:f)

name: proposition_5
statement:
theorem proposition_5 : ∀ (a b c d e : Point) (AB BC AC : Line),
  formTriangle a b c AB BC AC ∧ (|(a─b)| = |(a─c)|) ∧
  (between a b d) ∧ (between a c e) →
  (∠ a:b:c = ∠ a:c:b) ∧ (∠ c:b:d = ∠ b:c:e)

name: proposition_5'
statement:
theorem proposition_5' : ∀ (a b c : Point) (AB BC AC : Line),
  formTriangle a b c AB BC AC ∧ (|(a─b)| = |(a─c)|) →
  (∠ a:b:c = ∠ a:c:b)

name: proposition_44
statement:
theorem proposition_44 : ∀ (a b c₁ c₂ c₃ d₁ d₂ d₃ : Point) (AB C₁₂ C₂₃ C₃₁ D₁₂ D₂₃ : Line),
  formTriangle c₁ c₂ c₃ C₁₂ C₂₃ C₃₁ ∧ formRectilinearAngle d₁ d₂ d₃ D₁₂ D₂₃ ∧ distinctPointsOnLine a b AB ∧
  (∠ d₁:d₂:d₃ : ℝ) > 0 ∧ (∠ d₁:d₂:d₃ : ℝ) < ∟ + ∟ →
  ∃ (m l : Point) (BM AL ML : Line), formParallelogram b m a l BM AL AB ML ∧
  (∠ a:b:m = ∠ d₁:d₂:d₃) ∧ (triangle.area △ a:b:m + triangle.area △ a:l:m = triangle.area △ c₁:c₂:c₃)

name: proposition_44'
statement:
theorem proposition_44' : ∀ (a b c₁ c₂ c₃ d₁ d₂ d₃ x : Point) (AB C₁₂ C₂₃ C₃₁ D₁₂ D₂₃ : Line),
  formTriangle c₁ c₂ c₃ C₁₂ C₂₃ C₃₁ ∧ formRectilinearAngle d₁ d₂ d₃ D₁₂ D₂₃ ∧ distinctPointsOnLine a b AB ∧ ¬(x.onLine AB) ∧
  (∠ d₁:d₂:d₃ : ℝ) > 0 ∧ (∠ d₁:d₂:d₃ : ℝ) < ∟ + ∟ →
  ∃ (m l : Point) (BM AL ML : Line), Point.opposingSides m x AB ∧ formParallelogram b m a l BM AL AB ML ∧
  (∠ a:b:m : ℝ) = (∠ d₁:d₂:d₃) ∧ (triangle.area △ a:b:m) + (triangle.area △ a:l:m) = (triangle.area △ c₁:c₂:c₃)

name: proposition_13
statement:
theorem proposition_13 : ∀ (a b c d : Point) (AB CD : Line),
  AB ≠ CD ∧ distinctPointsOnLine a b AB ∧ distinctPointsOnLine c d CD ∧ between d b c →
  ∠ c:b:a + ∠ a:b:d = ∟ + ∟

name: proposition_29
statement:
theorem proposition_29 : ∀ (a b c d e f g h : Point) (AB CD EF : Line),
  distinctPointsOnLine a b AB ∧ distinctPointsOnLine c d CD ∧ distinctPointsOnLine e f EF ∧
  (between a g b) ∧ (between c h d) ∧ (between e g h) ∧ (between g h f) ∧ (b.sameSide d EF) ∧ ¬(AB.intersectsLine CD)
  → ∠ a:g:h = ∠ g:h:d ∧ ∠ e:g:b = ∠ g:h:d ∧ ∠ b:g:h + ∠ g:h:d = ∟ + ∟

name: proposition_29'
statement:
theorem proposition_29' : ∀ (a b c d e g h : Point) (AB CD EF : Line),
  distinctPointsOnLine a b AB ∧ distinctPointsOnLine c d CD ∧ distinctPointsOnLine g h EF ∧
  (between a g b) ∧ (between c h d) ∧ (between e g h) ∧ (b.sameSide d EF) ∧ ¬(AB.intersectsLine CD) →
  ∠ a:g:h = ∠ g:h:d ∧ ∠ e:g:b = ∠ g:h:d ∧ ∠ b:g:h + ∠ g:h:d = ∟ + ∟

name: proposition_29''
statement:
theorem proposition_29'' : ∀ (a b d g h : Point) (AB CD GH : Line),
  distinctPointsOnLine a b AB ∧ distinctPointsOnLine h d CD ∧ distinctPointsOnLine g h GH ∧
  (between a g b) ∧ (b.sameSide d GH) ∧ ¬(AB.intersectsLine CD) →
  ∠ a:g:h = ∠ g:h:d ∧ ∠ b:g:h + ∠ g:h:d = ∟ + ∟

name: proposition_29'''
statement:
theorem proposition_29''' : ∀ (a d g h : Point) (AB CD GH : Line),
  distinctPointsOnLine a g AB ∧ distinctPointsOnLine h d CD ∧ distinctPointsOnLine g h GH ∧
  a.opposingSides d GH ∧ ¬(AB.intersectsLine CD) →
  ∠ a:g:h = ∠ g:h:d

name: proposition_29''''
statement:
theorem proposition_29'''' : ∀ (b d e g h : Point) (AB CD EF : Line),
  distinctPointsOnLine g b AB ∧ distinctPointsOnLine h d CD ∧ distinctPointsOnLine e h EF ∧
  between e g h ∧ b.sameSide d EF ∧ ¬(AB.intersectsLine CD) →
  ∠ e:g:b = ∠ g:h:d

name: proposition_29'''''
statement:
theorem proposition_29''''' : ∀ (b d g h : Point) (AB CD EF : Line),
  distinctPointsOnLine g b AB ∧ distinctPointsOnLine h d CD ∧ distinctPointsOnLine g h EF ∧
  b.sameSide d EF ∧ ¬(AB.intersectsLine CD) →
  ∠ b:g:h + ∠ g:h:d = ∟ + ∟

name: exists_circumCentre
statement: theorem exists_circumCentre: ∀(A B C : Point), triangle A B C → ∃(O : Point), circumCentre O A B C
proof:
:= by
  euclid_intros
  euclid_apply threePoints_existCircle A B C as Ω
  euclid_apply exists_centre Ω as O
  use O
  euclid_finish

name: triangle_perpBisector_concurrent
statement: theorem triangle_perpBisector_concurrent: ∀(A B C: Point) (l1 l2 l3: Line), triangle A B C ∧ perpBisector A B l1 ∧ perpBisector B C l2 ∧ perpBisector A C l3 → concurrent l1 l2 l3
proof:
:= by
  euclid_intros
  euclid_apply exists_circumCentre A B C as O
  use O
  euclid_apply perpBisector_property
  euclid_finish

name: acute_triangle_circumCentre_inside
statement: theorem acute_triangle_circumCentre_inside: ∀(A B C O: Point) (AB BC CA : Line),formTriangle A B C AB BC CA ∧ acuteTriangle A B C ∧ circumCentre O A B C → insideTriangle O A B C AB BC CA
proof:
:= by
  euclid_intros
  euclid_apply circle_from_points O A as Ω
  have h1: O.sameSide A BC := by
    by_contra
    by_cases O.opposingSides A BC
    · euclid_apply inscribed_angle_theorem_opposingSide C B A O BC Ω
      euclid_finish
    · euclid_apply diameter_rightAngle B C A O Ω
      euclid_finish
  have h1: O.sameSide B CA := by
    by_contra
    by_cases O.opposingSides B CA
    · euclid_apply inscribed_angle_theorem_opposingSide A C B O CA Ω
      euclid_finish
    · euclid_apply diameter_rightAngle C A B O Ω
      euclid_finish
  have h1: O.sameSide C AB := by
    by_contra
    by_cases O.opposingSides C AB
    · euclid_apply inscribed_angle_theorem_opposingSide B A C O AB Ω
      euclid_finish
    · euclid_apply diameter_rightAngle A B C O Ω
      euclid_finish
  euclid_finish

name: isoTriangle_cos
statement: theorem isoTriangle_cos : ∀(A B C : Point), |(A─B)| = |(A─C)| ∧ B ≠ C → 2 * |(A─B)| * cos (∠A:B:C) = |(B─C)|
proof:
:= by
  euclid_intros
  euclid_apply line_from_points A B as AB
  by_cases coll A B C
  · euclid_assert midpoint B A C
    have  h1: 2 * |(A─B)| = |(B─C)| := by
      euclid_finish
    have h2: ∠ A:B:C = 0 := by
      euclid_finish
    euclid_apply Real.cos_zero
    euclid_finish
  · euclid_apply exists_midpoint B C as D
    have h1: ∠B:D:A = ∟ := by
      euclid_apply isoTriangle_threeLine_concidence_midpoint A B C D
      euclid_finish
    euclid_apply rightTriangle_cos D B A
    have h3 : ∠D:B:A = ∠A:B:C :=by
      euclid_apply angle_between_transfer
      euclid_finish
    euclid_finish

name: circumcenter_inscribed_angle_sameSide
statement:
theorem circumcenter_inscribed_angle_sameSide : ∀ (A B C O : Point) (AB: Line) (Ω : Circle), (distinctPointsOnLine A B AB) ∧ (O.sameSide C AB) ∧ (A.onCircle Ω) ∧ (B.onCircle Ω) ∧ (C.onCircle Ω) ∧ (O.isCentre Ω)
  → ∠ O:B:A +  ∠ A:C:B= ∟
proof:
:= by
  euclid_intros
  euclid_apply inscribed_angle_theorem_sameSide A B C O AB Ω
  euclid_apply isoTriangle_eqAngle O A B
  euclid_apply triangle_angleSum O A B
  euclid_finish

name: circumcenter_inscribed_angle_opposingSides
statement:
theorem circumcenter_inscribed_angle_opposingSides : ∀ (A B C O : Point) (AB: Line) (Ω : Circle), (distinctPointsOnLine A B AB) ∧ (O.opposingSides C AB) ∧ (A.onCircle Ω) ∧ (B.onCircle Ω) ∧ (C.onCircle Ω) ∧ (O.isCentre Ω)
  → ∠ A:C:B - ∠ O:B:A = ∟
proof:
:= by
  euclid_intros
  euclid_apply inscribed_angle_theorem_opposingSide A B C O AB Ω
  euclid_apply isoTriangle_eqAngle O A B
  euclid_apply triangle_angleSum O A B
  euclid_finish

name: law_of_sin_radius
statement: theorem law_of_sin_radius: ∀ (A B C O: Point), triangle A B C ∧ circumCentre O A B C → |(B─C)| = 2 * Real.sin (∠B:A:C) * |(A─O)|
proof:
:= by
  euclid_intros
  euclid_apply line_from_points B C as BC
  euclid_apply isoTriangle_cos O B C
  euclid_apply circle_from_points O A as Ω
  by_cases O.sameSide A BC
  · have h1: ∠O:C:B = ∟ - ∠B:A:C := by
      euclid_apply circumcenter_inscribed_angle_sameSide B C A O BC Ω
      euclid_finish
    have h2: |(B─C)| = 2 * |(A─O)| * cos (∠O:C:B) := by
      euclid_apply isoTriangle_cos O C B
      euclid_finish
    rw [h2, h1]
    euclid_apply rightAngle_eq_pi_div_two
    euclid_apply Real.cos_pi_div_two_sub (∠B:A:C)
    euclid_finish
  · by_cases O.opposingSides A BC
    · have h1: ∠O:C:B + ∟ =  ∠B:A:C := by
        euclid_apply circumcenter_inscribed_angle_opposingSides B C A O BC Ω
        euclid_finish
      have h2: |(B─C)| = 2 * |(A─O)| * cos (∠O:C:B) := by
        euclid_apply isoTriangle_cos O C B
        euclid_finish
      rw [h2, ← h1]
      euclid_apply rightAngle_eq_pi_div_two
      euclid_apply Real.sin_add_pi_div_two (∠O:C:B)
      euclid_finish
    · euclid_assert midpoint B O C
      euclid_apply diameter_rightAngle B C A O Ω
      euclid_apply sin_pi_div_two
      euclid_apply rightAngle_eq_pi_div_two
      euclid_finish

name: triangle_two_foot_intersects
statement: theorem triangle_two_foot_intersects : ∀ (A B C D E : Point) (AB BC CA AD BE: Line), formTriangle A B C AB BC CA ∧ foot A D BC ∧ foot B E CA ∧ distinctPointsOnLine A D AD ∧ distinctPointsOnLine B E BE → AD.intersectsLine BE
proof:
:= by
  euclid_intros
  by_contra
  euclid_assert perpLine AD BC
  euclid_apply perpLine_parallel_perpLine AD BC BE
  euclid_apply perpLine_parallel_perpLine BE CA AD
  euclid_assert ∠E:B:C = ∟
  by_cases E = C
  · euclid_finish
  · euclid_apply triangle_angleSum E B C
    euclid_apply triangle_anglePositive E B C
    euclid_finish

name: foot_coll_foot
statement: theorem foot_coll_foot: ∀ (A B H : Point) (l : Line), (foot A H l) ∧ (coll A B H) ∧ (B ≠ H) → foot B H l
proof:
:= by
  euclid_intros
  euclid_apply line_from_points A H as AH
  euclid_finish

name: two_foot_power
statement: theorem two_foot_power : ∀ (A B C D E : Point) (AB BC CA: Line), formTriangle A B C AB BC CA ∧ foot A D BC ∧ foot B E CA → |(C─D)| * |(C─B)| =|(C─E)| * |(C─A)|
proof:
:=  by
  euclid_intros
  by_cases ∠B:C:A = ∟
  · have h1: (E = C) ∧ (D = C) := by
      euclid_apply foot_unique B C E CA
      euclid_apply foot_unique A C D BC
      euclid_finish
    euclid_finish
  · have h2: ∠ A:C:D = ∠B:C:E := by
      by_cases ∠B:C:A < ∟
      · euclid_apply acute_angle_foot_equal A C B D BC
        euclid_apply acute_angle_foot_equal B C A E CA
        euclid_finish
      · have h3: between B C D := by
          euclid_apply obtuse_triangle_foot_between A C B D BC
          euclid_finish
        have h4: between A C E := by
          euclid_apply obtuse_triangle_foot_between B C A E CA
          euclid_finish
        have h5: ∠ A:C:D + ∠A:C:B = ∟ + ∟ := by
          euclid_apply angle_between_transfer
          euclid_finish
        have h6: ∠ B:C:E + ∠B:C:A = ∟ + ∟ := by
          euclid_apply angle_between_transfer
          euclid_finish
        euclid_finish
    euclid_apply similar_AA D C A E C B
    euclid_finish

name: exists_orthocenter
statement: theorem exists_orthocenter: ∀ (A B C D E F: Point) (AB BC CA: Line), formTriangle A B C AB BC CA ∧ foot A D BC ∧ foot B E CA ∧ foot C F AB → ∃ (H : Point), orthoCentre H A B C D E F AB BC CA
proof:
:= by
  euclid_intros
  euclid_apply line_from_points A D as AD
  euclid_apply line_from_points B E as BE
  euclid_apply triangle_two_foot_intersects A B C D E AB BC CA AD BE
  euclid_apply intersection_lines AD BE as H
  use H
  have h1: |(A─F)| * |(B─D)| * |(C─E)| = |(B─F)| * |(C─D)| * |(A─E)| := by
    have h11: |(C─D)| * |(C─B)| =|(C─E)| * |(A─C)| := by
      euclid_apply two_foot_power A B C D E AB BC CA
      euclid_finish
    have h12: |(A─E)| * |(A─C)| =|(A─F)| * |(B─A)| := by
      euclid_apply two_foot_power B C A E F BC CA AB
      euclid_finish
    have h13: |(B─F)| * |(B─A)| =|(B─D)| * |(C─B)| := by
      euclid_apply two_foot_power C A B F D CA AB BC
      euclid_finish
    have h14: |(C─D)| * |(C─B)| * (|(A─E)| * |(A─C)|) * (|(B─F)| * |(B─A)|) = |(C─E)| * |(A─C)| * |(A─F)| * |(B─A)| * |(B─D)| * |(C─B)| := by
      rw[h11,h12,h13]
      linarith
    have h15: |(A─F)| * |(B─D)| * |(C─E)| * (|(C─B)| * |(A─C)| * |(B─A)|) = |(B─F)| * |(C─D)| * |(A─E)| * (|(C─B)| * |(A─C)| * |(B─A)|):=  by
      calc
      _ = |(C─D)| * |(C─B)| * (|(A─E)| * |(A─C)|) * (|(B─F)| * |(B─A)|)  := by linarith
      _ = |(C─E)| * |(A─C)| * |(A─F)| * |(B─A)| * |(B─D)| * |(C─B)|  := by rw [h14]
      _ = _ := by linarith
    have h_nonzero: (|(C─B)| * |(A─C)| * |(B─A)|) ≠ 0 := by euclid_finish
    apply (mul_left_inj' h_nonzero).mp
    linarith
  have h2: coll C H F := by
    euclid_apply Ceva_inverse B C A E F D H
    euclid_finish
  euclid_finish

name: rightTriangle_orthocenter
statement:
theorem rightTriangle_orthocenter:
  ∀ (A B C H D E F : Point) (AB BC CA : Line),
    rightTriangle A B C →
    orthoCentre H A B C D E F AB BC CA →
    H = A
proof:
:= by
  euclid_intros
  have h1: (E = A) ∧ (F = A) := by
      euclid_apply foot_unique B A E CA
      euclid_apply foot_unique C A F AB
      euclid_finish
  euclid_finish

name: acuteTriangle_orthocenter
statement:
theorem acuteTriangle_orthocenter:
  ∀ (A B C H D E F : Point) (AB BC CA: Line),
    (formAcuteTriangle A B C AB BC CA) ∧ (orthoCentre H A B C D E F AB BC CA)
    → insideTriangle H A B C AB BC CA
proof:
:= by
  euclid_intros
  
  
  
  

  
  have h_between_BDC : between B D C := by
    euclid_apply acute_triangle_foot_between A B C D BC
    euclid_finish
  have h_between_AEC : between A E C := by
    euclid_apply acute_triangle_foot_between B C A E CA
    euclid_finish
  have h_between_AFB : between A F B := by
    euclid_apply acute_triangle_foot_between C A B F AB
    euclid_finish
  euclid_finish

name: acuteTriangle_orthocenter_transfer
statement: theorem acuteTriangle_orthocenter_transfer : ∀(A B C D E F H: Point) (AB BC CA AH BH: Line), acuteTriangle A B C ∧  distinctPointsOnLine A H AH ∧ distinctPointsOnLine B H BH ∧ orthoCentre H A B C D E F AB BC CA → orthoCentre C A B H E D F AB BH AH
proof:
:= by
  euclid_intros
  have h1 : insideTriangle H A B C AB BC CA := by
    euclid_apply acuteTriangle_orthocenter A B C H D E F AB BC CA
    euclid_finish
  euclid_apply foot_coll_foot C H F AB
  euclid_finish

name: acuteTriangle_power_of_orthocenter
statement:
theorem acuteTriangle_power_of_orthocenter :
  ∀ (A B C D E F H : Point) (AB BC CA : Line),
    acuteTriangle A B C ∧
    orthoCentre H A B C D E F AB BC CA
    → |(A─H)| * |(H─D)| = |(B─H)| * |(H─E)|
proof:
:= by
  euclid_intros
  have h1 : insideTriangle H A B C AB BC CA := by
    euclid_apply acuteTriangle_orthocenter A B C H D E F AB BC CA
    euclid_finish
  euclid_apply line_from_points B H as BH
  euclid_apply line_from_points A H as AH
  have h1: orthoCentre C A B H E D F AB BH AH := by
    euclid_apply acuteTriangle_orthocenter_transfer A B C D E F H AB BC CA AH BH
    euclid_finish
  euclid_apply two_foot_power A B H E D AB BH AH
  euclid_finish

name: sin_rightAngle
statement: theorem sin_rightAngle : sin ∟ = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [rightAngle_eq_pi_div_two]
  rw [Real.sin_pi_div_two]

name: cos_rightAngle
statement: theorem cos_rightAngle : cos ∟ = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [rightAngle_eq_pi_div_two]
  rw [Real.cos_pi_div_two]

name: straightAngle_eq_pi
statement: theorem straightAngle_eq_pi: ∟ + ∟ = Real.pi
proof:
:= by
  rw[rightAngle_eq_pi_div_two]
  linarith

name: eq_sine_if_coll
statement: theorem eq_sine_if_coll: ∀ (A B C D: Point), Coll A B C  ∧ (B ≠ C) ∧ (B ≠ A) ∧ (C ≠ A) ∧ ¬ (Coll A B D) →  sin (∠ D:B:C) = sin (∠ D:B:A)
proof:
:= by
  euclid_intros
  euclid_apply coll_eq_or_supp_angles A B C D
  by_cases ∠D:B:C = ∠D:B:A
  · euclid_finish
  · have h1: ∠ D:B:A = π/2 + π/2 - ∠ D:B:C := by
      rw[← rightAngle_eq_pi_div_two]
      euclid_finish
    have h2: ∠ D:B:A = π - ∠ D:B:C := by
      euclid_finish
    rw[h2,sin_pi_sub]

name: triangleArea_sine
statement: theorem triangleArea_sine : ∀ (A B C : Point), Triangle A B C → (△A:B:C).area = |(A─B)| * |(A─C)| * sin (∠B:A:C) / 2
proof:
:= by
  euclid_intros
  euclid_apply line_from_points A C as AC
  euclid_apply exists_foot B AC as E
  euclid_apply triangle_area_foot B A C E AC
  by_cases (E ≠ A)
  · have h1: RightTriangle E A B := by
      euclid_finish
    have h2: sin (∠B:A:C) = sin (∠E:A:B) := by
      euclid_apply eq_sine_if_coll
      euclid_finish
    have h3: sin (∠E:A:B) = |(E─B)| / |(A─B)| := by
      euclid_apply rightTriangle_sin E A B
      euclid_finish
    rw [h2, h3]
    euclid_finish
  · have h1: (∠B:A:C) = ∟ := by
      euclid_finish
    have h2: sin (∠B:A:C) = 1 := by
      euclid_apply rightAngle_eq_pi_div_two
      euclid_finish
    have h3: |(B─E)| * |(A─C)| / 2 = |(A─B)| * |(A─C)| / 2 := by
      euclid_finish
    euclid_finish

name: LawOfSines
statement: theorem LawOfSines : ∀ (A B C : Point), Triangle A B C → |(A─C)| * sin (∠B:C:A)= |(A─B)| * sin (∠A:B:C)
proof:
:= by
    euclid_intros
    have h1 : |(B─C)| * |(A─C)| * sin (∠B:C:A)= |(B─C)| * |(A─B)| * sin (∠A:B:C) := by
      euclid_apply triangleArea_sine
      euclid_finish
    euclid_finish

name: LawOfCosines
statement: theorem LawOfCosines : ∀ (A B C : Point), Triangle A B C → |(A─B)| * |(A─B)| + |(A─C)| * |(A─C)| - |(B─C)| * |(B─C)| = 2 * cos (∠B:A:C) * |(A─B)| * |(A─C)|
proof:
:= by
  euclid_intros
  euclid_apply line_from_points A C as AC
  euclid_apply exists_foot B AC as H
  euclid_apply line_from_points B H as BH
  euclid_apply perpLine_imp_eq_sq_diff B H A C BH AC
  have h1: between A H C ∨ between H A C ∨ between A C H ∨ H = A ∨ H = C := by
    euclid_finish
  rcases h1 with h01|h02|h03|h04|h05
  · have h1: cos (∠B:A:C) = |(A─H)| / |(A─B)| := by
      have h2: ∠B:A:H = ∠B:A:C := by
        euclid_apply coll_angles_eq A H C B
        euclid_finish
      euclid_apply rightTriangle_cos H A B
      euclid_finish
    rw[h1]
    have h3: |(A─H)| + |(H─C)| = |(A─C)| := by
      euclid_finish
    euclid_finish
  · have h4: cos (∠B:A:C) = - (|(A─H)| / |(A─B)|):= by
      have h5: ∠B:A:C = ∟ + ∟ - ∠B:A:H:= by
        euclid_apply coll_angles_eq H A C B
        euclid_finish
      have h6: cos (∠B:A:H) = |(A─H)| / |(A─B)|:= by
        euclid_apply rightTriangle_cos H A B
        euclid_finish
      rw[h5, ←h6, straightAngle_eq_pi, Real.cos_pi_sub]
    rw[h4]
    have h7: |(A─H)| + |(A─C)| = |(H─C)| := by
      euclid_finish
    euclid_finish
  · have h1: cos (∠B:A:C) = |(A─H)| / |(A─B)| := by
      have h2: ∠B:A:H = ∠B:A:C := by
        euclid_apply coll_angles_eq A C H B
        euclid_finish
      euclid_apply rightTriangle_cos H A B
      euclid_finish
    rw[h1]
    have h3: |(A─C)| + |(H─C)| = |(A─H)| := by
      euclid_finish
    euclid_finish
  · have h1: ∠ B:A:C = ∟ := by
      euclid_finish
    rw[h1,cos_rightAngle]
    euclid_apply PythagoreanTheorem_point A B C
    euclid_finish
  · euclid_apply PythagoreanTheorem_point C B A
    euclid_apply rightTriangle_cos C A B
    euclid_finish

name: GeneralizedAngleBisectorTheorem
statement: theorem GeneralizedAngleBisectorTheorem: ∀ (A B C D : Point), Triangle A B C ∧ Coll B C D → |(D─C)| * |(A─B)| * sin (∠D:A:B) = |(D─B)| * |(A─C)| * sin (∠D:A:C)
proof:
:= by
  euclid_intros
  euclid_apply line_from_points A B as AB
  euclid_apply line_from_points B C as BC
  euclid_apply line_from_points A C as AC
  by_cases D = B ∨ D = C
  · by_cases h2: D = B
    · have h1: ∠D:A:B = 0 := by
        euclid_finish
      euclid_apply Real.sin_zero
      euclid_finish
    · have h1: ∠D:A:C = 0 := by
        euclid_finish
      euclid_apply Real.sin_zero
      euclid_finish
  · have h1: |(A─B)| * sin (∠D:A:B) = |(B─D)| * sin (∠ A:D:B):= by
      euclid_apply LawOfSines B A D
      euclid_finish
    have h2: |(A─C)| * sin (∠D:A:C) = |(C─D)| * sin (∠ A:D:C):= by
      euclid_apply LawOfSines C A D
      euclid_finish
    have h3: sin (∠A:D:B) =  sin (∠A:D:C) := by
      euclid_apply eq_sine_if_coll B D C A
      euclid_finish
    euclid_finish

name: GeneralizedAngleBisectorTheorem_to_midpoint
statement: theorem GeneralizedAngleBisectorTheorem_to_midpoint : ∀ (A B C D : Point), Triangle A B C ∧ MidPoint B D C → |(A─B)| * sin (∠D:A:B) = |(A─C)| * sin (∠D:A:C)
proof:
:= by
  euclid_intros
  euclid_apply GeneralizedAngleBisectorTheorem A B C D
  euclid_finish

name: coll_triangleArea_ratio_eq_seg_ratio
statement: theorem coll_triangleArea_ratio_eq_seg_ratio: ∀ (a b c d: Point),  Coll b c d → (△a:b:d).area * |(b─c)| = (△a:b:c).area * |(b─d)|
proof:
:= by
  euclid_intros
  euclid_apply coll_def b c d as l
  by_cases ¬ a.onLine l
  · by_cases DistinctThreePoints b c d
    · euclid_apply exists_foot a l as e
      euclid_apply triangle_area_foot a b c e l
      euclid_apply triangle_area_foot a b d e l
      euclid_finish
    · euclid_finish
  · euclid_finish

name: triangleArea_pos
statement: theorem triangleArea_pos: ∀(A B C : Point), Triangle A B C → (△A:B:C).area >0

name: coll_triangleArea_add
statement: theorem coll_triangleArea_add: ∀(A B C D: Point), between B D C→ (△A:B:D).area +  (△A:C:D).area = (△A:B:C).area

name: coll_triangleArea_ratio_eq_seg_ratio2
statement: theorem coll_triangleArea_ratio_eq_seg_ratio2: ∀ (a b c d e: Point), Coll a e d ∧ Coll b c d → (△a:b:e).area * |(d─c)| = (△c:a:e).area * |(d─b)|
proof:
:= by
  euclid_intros
  have h1: (△a:d:c).area * |(d─b)| = (△a:d:b).area * |(d─c)| := by
    euclid_apply coll_triangleArea_ratio_eq_seg_ratio a d b c
    euclid_finish
  have h2: (△e:d:c).area * |(d─b)| = (△e:d:b).area * |(d─c)| := by
    euclid_apply coll_triangleArea_ratio_eq_seg_ratio e d b c
    euclid_finish
  euclid_apply coll_triangleArea_add
  euclid_finish

name: MenelausTheorem
statement: theorem MenelausTheorem : ∀ (A B C L M N: Point) (AB BC CA l :Line), formTriangle A B C AB BC CA  ∧  L.onLine l ∧ L.onLine BC ∧ M.onLine l ∧ M.onLine CA ∧ N.onLine l ∧ N.onLine AB → |(N─A)| * |(L─B)| * |(M─C)| = |(N─B)| * |(L─C)| * |(M─A)|
proof:
:= by
  euclid_intros
  have h1: (△L:N:B).area * |(N─A)| = (△L:N:A).area * |(N─B)| := by
    euclid_apply coll_triangleArea_ratio_eq_seg_ratio L N A B
    euclid_finish
  have h2: (△L:N:C).area * |(L─B)| = (△L:N:B).area * |(L─C)| := by
    euclid_apply coll_triangleArea_ratio_eq_seg_ratio N L B C
    euclid_finish
  have h3: (△L:N:A).area * |(M─C)| = (△L:N:C).area * |(M─A)| := by
    euclid_apply coll_triangleArea_ratio_eq_seg_ratio2 N A C M L
    euclid_finish
  have h4: |(N─A)| * |(L─B)| * |(M─C)| * ((△L:N:A).area * (△L:N:B).area *  (△L:N:C).area) = |(N─B)| * |(L─C)| * |(M─A)| * ((△L:N:A).area * (△L:N:B).area *  (△L:N:C).area) := by
    calc
      |(N─A)| * |(L─B)| * |(M─C)| * ((△L:N:A).area * (△L:N:B).area * (△L:N:C).area) = ((△L:N:B).area * |(N─A)|) * ((△L:N:C).area * |(L─B)|) * ((△L:N:A).area * |(M─C)|) := by ring_nf
      _ = ((△L:N:A).area * |(N─B)|) * ((△L:N:B).area * |(L─C)|) * ((△L:N:C).area * |(M─A)|) := by rw[h1,h2,h3]
      _ = _ := by ring_nf
  by_cases (△L:N:A).area > 0 ∧ (△L:N:B).area > 0 ∧ (△L:N:C).area > 0
  · have h5: (△L:N:A).area * (△L:N:B).area * (△L:N:C).area ≠ 0 := by
      euclid_finish
    apply (mul_left_inj' h5).mp
    linarith
  · euclid_finish

name: CevaTheorem
statement: theorem CevaTheorem : ∀ (A B C D E F O: Point), (Triangle A B C) ∧ Coll A F B ∧ Coll A E C ∧ Coll B D C ∧ Coll A O D ∧ Coll C O F ∧ Coll B O E → |(B─D)| * |(C─E)| * |(A─F)| = |(D─C)| * |(E─A)| * |(F─B)|
proof:
:= by
  euclid_intros
  by_cases (△B:O:A).area > 0 ∧ (△A:O:C).area > 0 ∧ (△B:O:C).area > 0
  · have h1: |(B─D)| * (△A:O:C).area = |(D─C)| * (△B:O:A).area:= by
      euclid_apply coll_triangleArea_ratio_eq_seg_ratio2 A B C D O
      euclid_finish
    have h2: |(C─E)| * (△B:O:A).area = |(E─A)| * (△B:O:C).area:= by
      euclid_apply coll_triangleArea_ratio_eq_seg_ratio2 B C A E O
      euclid_finish
    have h3: |(A─F)| * (△B:O:C).area = |(F─B)| * (△A:O:C).area:= by
      euclid_apply coll_triangleArea_ratio_eq_seg_ratio2 C A B F O
      euclid_finish
    have h4: |(B─D)| * |(C─E)| * |(A─F)| * ((△A:O:C).area * (△B:O:A).area * (△B:O:C).area) = |(D─C)| * |(E─A)| * |(F─B)| * ((△A:O:C).area * (△B:O:A).area * (△B:O:C).area):= by
      calc
        |(B─D)| * |(C─E)| * |(A─F)| * ((△A:O:C).area * (△B:O:A).area * (△B:O:C).area) = (|(B─D)| * (△A:O:C).area) * (|(C─E)| * (△B:O:A).area) * (|(A─F)| * (△B:O:C).area) := by ring_nf
        _ = (|(D─C)| * (△B:O:A).area) * (|(E─A)| * (△B:O:C).area) * (|(F─B)| * (△A:O:C).area) := by rw[h1,h2,h3]
        _ = _ := by ring_nf
    have h5: (△A:O:C).area * (△B:O:A).area * (△B:O:C).area ≠ 0 := by
      euclid_finish
    apply (mul_left_inj' h5).mp
    linarith
  · euclid_apply line_from_points A D as AD
    euclid_apply line_from_points B E as BE
    euclid_apply line_from_points C F as CF
    euclid_apply line_from_points A C as AC
    euclid_apply line_from_points A B as AB
    euclid_apply line_from_points B C as BC
    euclid_finish

name: AngleBisectorTheorem
statement: theorem AngleBisectorTheorem : ∀ (A B C D: Point), Triangle A B C ∧ ∠D:A:B = ∠D:A:C ∧ Coll B D C → |(A─C)| * |(B─D)| = |(A─B)| * |(C─D)|
proof:
:= by
  euclid_intros
  euclid_apply between_if_angles_sum A B C D
  have h0: (△D:A:C).area * |(D─B)| = (△D:A:B).area * |(D─C)| := by
    euclid_apply coll_triangleArea_ratio_eq_seg_ratio A D B C
    euclid_finish
  euclid_apply line_from_points A B as AB
  euclid_apply line_from_points A C as AC
  euclid_apply exists_foot D AB as E
  euclid_apply exists_foot D AC as F
  have h1: (△D:A:B).area = |(D─E)| * |(A─B)| / 2 := by
    euclid_apply triangle_area_foot D A B E AB
    euclid_finish
  have h2: (△D:A:C).area = |(D─F)| * |(A─C)| / 2 := by
    euclid_apply triangle_area_foot D A C F AC
    euclid_finish
  have h3: |(D─E)| = |(D─F)| := by
    euclid_apply line_from_points
    euclid_apply acuteAngle_foot_eq_angles D A B E AB
    euclid_apply acuteAngle_foot_eq_angles D A C F AC
    euclid_apply congruentTriangles_AAS D A E D A F
    euclid_finish
  rw [h1,h2,h3] at h0
  euclid_finish

name: perpLine_imp_rightAngle
statement: theorem perpLine_imp_rightAngle : ∀ (P Q R: Point) (L1 L2 : Line), PerpLine L1 L2 ∧ TwoLinesIntersectAtPoint L1 L2 P ∧ Q.onLine L1 ∧ R.onLine L2 ∧ Q ≠ P ∧ R ≠ P → ∠Q:P:R = ∟

name: foot_unique
statement: theorem foot_unique: ∀ (c h g: Point) (AB : Line), Foot c h AB ∧ Foot c g AB → h = g
proof:
:= by

    euclid_finish

name: perpLine_imp_eq_sq_diff
statement: theorem perpLine_imp_eq_sq_diff : ∀ (A B P Q : Point) (AB PQ : Line), distinctPointsOnLine A B AB ∧ distinctPointsOnLine P Q PQ ∧ PerpLine AB PQ → |(A─P)| * |(A─P)| - |(A─Q)| * |(A─Q)| = |(B─P)| * |(B─P)| - |(B─Q)| * |(B─Q)|
proof:
:= by
    euclid_intros
    euclid_apply intersection_lines AB PQ as R
    by_cases h : R ≠ A ∧ R ≠ B ∧ R ≠ P ∧ R ≠ Q
    · euclid_apply PythagoreanTheorem_point R P A
      euclid_apply PythagoreanTheorem_point R Q A
      euclid_apply PythagoreanTheorem_point R P B
      euclid_apply PythagoreanTheorem_point R Q B
      euclid_finish
    · have h_1 : R = A ∨ R = B ∨ R = P ∨ R = Q := by
        euclid_finish
      rcases h_1 with h1|h2|h3|h4
      · by_cases R ≠ P ∧ R ≠ Q
        · euclid_apply PythagoreanTheorem_point R P B
          euclid_apply PythagoreanTheorem_point R Q B
          euclid_finish
        · by_cases R = P
          · euclid_apply PythagoreanTheorem_point R Q B
            euclid_finish
          · have tmp : R = Q := by euclid_finish
            euclid_apply PythagoreanTheorem_point R P B
            euclid_finish
      · by_cases R ≠ P ∧ R ≠ Q
        · euclid_apply PythagoreanTheorem_point R P A
          euclid_apply PythagoreanTheorem_point R Q A
          euclid_finish
        · by_cases R = P
          · euclid_apply PythagoreanTheorem_point R Q A
            euclid_finish
          · have tmp : R = Q := by euclid_finish
            euclid_apply PythagoreanTheorem_point R P A
            euclid_finish
      · by_cases R ≠ A ∧ R ≠ B
        · euclid_apply PythagoreanTheorem_point R Q A
          euclid_apply PythagoreanTheorem_point R Q B
          euclid_finish
        · by_cases R = A
          · euclid_apply PythagoreanTheorem_point R Q B
            euclid_finish
          · have tmp : R = B := by euclid_finish
            euclid_apply PythagoreanTheorem_point R Q A
            euclid_finish
      · by_cases R ≠ A ∧ R ≠ B
        · euclid_apply PythagoreanTheorem_point R P A
          euclid_apply PythagoreanTheorem_point R P B
          euclid_finish
        · by_cases R = A
          · euclid_apply PythagoreanTheorem_point R P B
            euclid_finish
          · have tmp : R = B := by euclid_finish
            euclid_apply PythagoreanTheorem_point R P A
            euclid_finish

name: sq_diff_unique_onLine
statement: theorem sq_diff_unique_onLine: ∀ (A B C D : Point) (AB : Line), distinctPointsOnLine A B AB ∧ C.onLine AB ∧ D.onLine AB ∧ |(C─A)| * |(C─A)| - |(C─B)| * |(C─B)| = |(D─A)| * |(D─A)| - |(D─B)| * |(D─B)| → C = D
proof:
:= by
    euclid_finish

name: perpLine_if_eq_sq_diff_lemma
statement: theorem perpLine_if_eq_sq_diff_lemma : ∀ (A B P Q : Point) (AB PQ : Line), distinctPointsOnLine A B AB ∧ distinctPointsOnLine P Q PQ ∧ |(A─P)| * |(A─P)| - |(A─Q)| * |(A─Q)| = |(B─P)| * |(B─P)| - |(B─Q)| * |(B─Q)| ∧ (A.onLine PQ ∨ B.onLine PQ ∨ P.onLine AB ∨ Q.onLine AB) → PerpLine AB PQ
proof:
:= by
  euclid_intros
  rcases right_3 with h1|h2|h3|h4
  · by_cases B.onLine PQ
    · euclid_apply sq_diff_unique_onLine P Q A B PQ
      euclid_finish
    · euclid_apply exists_foot B PQ as C
      euclid_apply line_from_points B C as BC
      euclid_apply perpLine_imp_eq_sq_diff B C P Q BC PQ
      euclid_apply sq_diff_unique_onLine P Q A C PQ
      euclid_finish
  · by_cases A.onLine PQ
    · euclid_apply sq_diff_unique_onLine P Q A B PQ
      euclid_finish
    · euclid_apply exists_foot A PQ as C
      euclid_apply line_from_points A C as AC
      euclid_apply perpLine_imp_eq_sq_diff A C P Q AC PQ
      euclid_apply sq_diff_unique_onLine P Q B C PQ
      euclid_finish
  · by_cases Q.onLine AB
    · euclid_apply sq_diff_unique_onLine A B P Q AB
      euclid_finish
    · euclid_apply exists_foot Q AB as R
      euclid_apply line_from_points Q R as QR
      euclid_apply perpLine_imp_eq_sq_diff Q R A B QR AB
      euclid_apply sq_diff_unique_onLine A B P R AB
      euclid_finish
  · by_cases P.onLine AB
    · euclid_apply sq_diff_unique_onLine A B P Q AB
      euclid_finish
    · euclid_apply exists_foot P AB as R
      euclid_apply line_from_points P R as PR
      euclid_apply perpLine_imp_eq_sq_diff P R A B PR AB
      euclid_apply sq_diff_unique_onLine A B Q R AB
      euclid_finish

name: perpLine_if_eq_sq_diff
statement: theorem perpLine_if_eq_sq_diff : ∀ (A B P Q : Point) (AB PQ : Line), distinctPointsOnLine A B AB ∧ distinctPointsOnLine P Q PQ ∧ |(A─P)| * |(A─P)| - |(A─Q)| * |(A─Q)| = |(B─P)| * |(B─P)| - |(B─Q)| * |(B─Q)| → PerpLine AB PQ
proof:
:= by
    euclid_intros
    by_cases h_0 : A.onLine PQ ∨ B.onLine PQ ∨ P.onLine AB ∨ Q.onLine AB
    · euclid_apply perpLine_if_eq_sq_diff_lemma A B P Q AB PQ
      euclid_finish
    · euclid_apply exists_foot P AB as R
      euclid_apply exists_foot Q AB as R'
      euclid_apply line_from_points P R as PR
      euclid_apply line_from_points Q R' as QR'
      euclid_apply perpLine_imp_eq_sq_diff P R A B PR AB
      euclid_apply perpLine_imp_eq_sq_diff Q R' A B QR' AB
      euclid_apply sq_diff_unique_onLine A B R R' AB
      by_cases A ≠ R
      · euclid_apply common_perpLine_imp_coll A R P Q
        euclid_finish
      · euclid_apply common_perpLine_imp_coll B R P Q
        euclid_finish

name: PythagoreanTheorem_converse
statement: theorem PythagoreanTheorem_converse : ∀ (a b c: Point), (Triangle a b c) ∧ |(b─c)| * |(b─c)| = |(b─a)| * |(b─a)| + |(a─c)| * |(a─c)| → ∠ b:a:c = ∟
proof:
:= by
    euclid_intros
    euclid_apply line_from_points a c as AC
    euclid_apply exists_foot b AC as d
    euclid_apply line_from_points b d as BD
    euclid_apply perpLine_imp_eq_sq_diff a c b d AC BD
    euclid_finish

:= by

    by_contra h_not_coll

name: sq_diff_mono_distinctTwoPointsOnLine
statement: theorem sq_diff_mono_distinctTwoPointsOnLine : ∀ (A B C D: Point) (AB : Line), distinctPointsOnLine A B AB ∧ ((LiesOnRay B A C ∧ LiesOnRay C B D) ∨ (C = B ∧ between A C D) ∨ (between A B C ∧ between A C D)) → |(C─A)| * |(C─A)| - |(C─B)| * |(C─B)| < |(D─A)| * |(D─A)| - |(D─B)| * |(D─B)|

  euclid_finish

name: sq_diff_mono_distinctTwoPointsOnLine'
statement: theorem sq_diff_mono_distinctTwoPointsOnLine' : ∀ (A B C D: Point) (AB : Line), distinctPointsOnLine A B AB ∧ C.onLine AB ∧ D.onLine AB ∧ |(C─A)| * |(C─A)| - |(C─B)| * |(C─B)| < |(D─A)| * |(D─A)| - |(D─B)| * |(D─B)| → ((LiesOnRay B A C ∧ LiesOnRay C B D) ∨ (C = B ∧ between A C D) ∨ (between A B C ∧ between A C D))
proof:
:= by
  euclid_intros
  by_contra
  by_cases C = D
  · euclid_finish
  · euclid_apply sq_diff_mono_distinctTwoPointsOnLine A B D C AB
    euclid_finish

name: sq_diff_mono_distinctThreePointsOnLine
statement: theorem sq_diff_mono_distinctThreePointsOnLine : ∀ (A B C D E: Point) (AB : Line), distinctPointsOnLine A B AB ∧ C.onLine AB ∧ D.onLine AB ∧ E.onLine AB ∧ |(C─A)| * |(C─A)| - |(C─B)| * |(C─B)| < |(D─A)| * |(D─A)| - |(D─B)| * |(D─B)| ∧ |(D─A)| * |(D─A)| - |(D─B)| * |(D─B)| < |(E─A)| * |(E─A)| - |(E─B)| * |(E─B)| → between C D E
proof:
:= by
  euclid_intros
  by_contra
  euclid_apply sq_diff_mono_distinctTwoPointsOnLine' A B C D AB
  euclid_apply sq_diff_mono_distinctTwoPointsOnLine' A B D E AB
  euclid_finish

name: exists_perpBisector'
statement: theorem exists_perpBisector' (a b : Point) : (a ≠ b) →  ∃ L, PerpBisector a b L ∧ ∃ M : Point, M.onLine L ∧ MidPoint a M b
proof:
:= by
  intro hab
  obtain ⟨AB, ha, hb⟩ := line_from_points a b hab
  euclid_apply (proposition_1 a b AB) as c
  euclid_apply (line_from_points c a) as AC
  euclid_apply (line_from_points c b ) as BC
  euclid_apply (proposition_9' c a b AC BC) as d'
  euclid_apply (line_from_points c d') as CD
  use CD
  have crux : PerpBisector a b CD := by
    use hab
    intro x hx
    cases em (c = x) with
    | inl hl =>
      rw [← hl]
      euclid_finish
    | inr hr =>
      obtain ⟨AX, ha', hx⟩ := line_from_points a x (by euclid_finish)
      obtain ⟨XC, hx', hc'⟩ := line_from_points x c (fun a => hr (id (Eq.symm a)))
      obtain  ⟨BX, hx'', hb'⟩ := line_from_points b x (by euclid_finish)
      have : ∠ a:c:x = ∠ b:c:x := by
        have : x.sameSide d' AC ∧ x.sameSide d' BC ∨ x.opposingSides d' AC ∧ x.opposingSides d' BC := by euclid_finish
        cases this with
        | inl hrl => euclid_finish
        | inr hrr =>
          have : ∠ a:c:x + ∠ a:c:d' = ∟ + ∟ := by
            apply coll_supp_angles
            euclid_finish
          have : ∠ b:c:x + ∠ b:c:d' = ∟ + ∟ := by
            apply coll_supp_angles
            euclid_finish
          euclid_finish
      euclid_apply proposition_4 c a x c b x AC AX XC BC BX XC
      euclid_finish
  apply And.intro
  · tauto
  · euclid_apply (intersection_lines CD AB) as d
    use d
    euclid_finish

name: exists_perpBisector
statement: theorem exists_perpBisector (a b : Point) : (a ≠ b) →  ∃ L, PerpBisector a b L
proof:
:= by
  intro hab
  obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ := exists_perpBisector' a b hab
  use L
  exact hL.1

name: exists_midpoint
statement: theorem exists_midpoint : ∀ (A B : Point), A ≠ B → ∃(P : Point), MidPoint A P B
proof:
:= by
  intro A B h
  obtain ⟨AB, hA, hB⟩ := line_from_points A B h
  obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ := exists_perpBisector' A B h
  obtain ⟨M, hM1, hM2⟩ := intersection_lines AB L (by euclid_finish)
  use M
  euclid_finish

name: exists_foot

theorem exists_foot : ∀ (c: Point) (AB : Line),

name: exists_perpLine
statement: theorem exists_perpLine : ∀ (P : Point) (L : Line), ∃ (M : Line), P.onLine M ∧ PerpLine M L
proof:
:= by
    euclid_intros
    by_cases h: P.onLine L
    · euclid_apply exists_distincts_points_on_line L P as R
      euclid_apply extend_point L R P as T
      euclid_apply proposition_11 T R P L as Q
      euclid_apply line_from_points P Q as PQ
      use PQ
      euclid_finish
    · obtain ⟨A', hA'⟩ := exists_foot P L (by euclid_finish)
      obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := line_from_points P A' (by euclid_finish)
      use M
      euclid_finish

name: exists_angleBisector
statement:
theorem exists_angleBisector : ∀ (A B C : Point),
(A ≠ B) ∧ (B ≠ C) ∧ ¬(Coll A B C)
→ ∃ (L : Line), B.onLine L ∧ (∀ (P: Point), P ≠ B → (P.onLine L ↔ ∠ A:B:P = ∠ P:B:C))
proof:
:= by
  euclid_intros
  euclid_apply line_from_points A B as AB
  euclid_apply line_from_points B C as BC
  euclid_apply proposition_9' B A C AB BC as P'
  euclid_apply line_from_points P' B as L
  use L
  constructor
  · euclid_finish
  · euclid_intros
    constructor
    · intros
      have h0 : between P B P' ∨ between B P P' ∨ between B P' P ∨ P = B ∨ P = P' := by
        euclid_finish
      rcases h0 with h1|h2|h3|h4|h5
      · euclid_apply coll_angles_eq P B P' A
        euclid_apply coll_angles_eq P B P' C
        euclid_finish
      · euclid_apply coll_angles_eq B P P' A
        euclid_apply coll_angles_eq B P P' C
        euclid_finish
      · euclid_apply coll_angles_eq B P' P A
        euclid_apply coll_angles_eq B P' P C
        euclid_finish
      · euclid_finish
      · euclid_finish
    · intros
      euclid_apply line_from_points P B as PB
      by_cases P.sameSide P' AB
      · euclid_apply coll_if_eq_angles A B P' P AB
        euclid_finish
      · euclid_apply point_on_line_same_side AB PB P' as P''
        euclid_apply coll_if_eq_angles A B P' P'' AB
        euclid_finish

name: exists_point_not_on_line

    euclid_apply exists_distincts_points_on_line L B as C
    euclid_apply exists_point_between_points_not_on_line L M B C as A

name: coll_straightAngle

name: coll_supp_angles
statement: theorem coll_supp_angles : ∀ (D A B C: Point), (between A B C) ∧ (¬ Coll A B D) → ∠D:B:A + ∠D:B:C = ∟ + ∟
proof:
:= by
  euclid_intros
  euclid_apply line_from_points A B as AB
  euclid_apply line_from_points B D as BD
  euclid_apply proposition_13 D B C A BD AB

name: coll_angles_eq
statement: theorem coll_angles_eq : ∀ (A B C D : Point), between A B C ∧ ¬ Coll A B D → ∠D:C:B = ∠D:C:A ∧ ∠D:B:C + ∠D:B:A = ∟ + ∟ ∧ ∠D:A:B = ∠D:A:C
proof:
:= by
  euclid_intros
  constructor
  · euclid_apply line_from_points
    euclid_finish
  · constructor
    · euclid_apply coll_supp_angles
      euclid_finish
    · euclid_apply line_from_points
      euclid_finish

name: nondegenerate_angle_if
statement: theorem nondegenerate_angle_if : ∀ (A B C : Point), ¬ Coll A B C → ∠A:B:C > 0 ∧ ∠A:B:C < ∟ + ∟
proof:
:= by

  euclid_apply extend_point AB A B as D

name: nondegenerate_angle_onlyif
statement: theorem nondegenerate_angle_onlyif : ∀ (A B C : Point), ∠A:B:C > 0 ∧ ∠A:B:C < ∟ + ∟ ∧ A ≠ B ∧ B ≠ C → ¬ Coll A B C
proof:
:= by
  euclid_intros
  euclid_apply coincident_angle_eq_zero
  euclid_apply coll_straightAngle
  euclid_apply coll_zeroAngle

name: coll_if_eq_angles
statement: theorem coll_if_eq_angles : ∀(A B C D: Point) (AB : Line), distinctPointsOnLine A B AB ∧ (∠A:B:C = ∠A:B:D) ∧ D.sameSide C AB → Coll B C D
proof:
:= by
  euclid_intros
  euclid_apply line_from_points B C as BC
  have h1: ¬ (D.sameSide A BC):= by
    euclid_finish
  have h2:  ¬ (D.opposingSides A BC) := by
    by_contra
    euclid_apply line_from_points
    euclid_assert ∠D:B:C + ∠A:B:C = ∠D:B:A
    euclid_finish
  euclid_finish

name: coll_if_supp_angles
statement: theorem coll_if_supp_angles : ∀(A B C D: Point) (AB : Line), distinctPointsOnLine A B AB ∧ (∠A:B:C + ∠A:B:D = ∟ + ∟ ) ∧ D.opposingSides C AB → between C B D
proof:
:= by
  euclid_intros
  euclid_apply line_from_points B D as BD
  euclid_apply extend_point BD D B as E
  euclid_apply coll_angles_eq
  euclid_assert E.sameSide C AB
  euclid_apply coll_if_eq_angles A B C E
  euclid_finish

name: coll_eq_or_supp_angles
statement:
theorem coll_eq_or_supp_angles: ∀ (A B C D: Point), Coll A B C  ∧ (B ≠ C) ∧ (B ≠ A) ∧ (C ≠ A) ∧ ¬ ( Coll A B D)→
  ∠ D:B:C = ∠ D:B:A ∨ ∠ D:B:C + ∠D:B:A = ∟ + ∟
proof:
:= by
  euclid_intros
  euclid_apply line_from_points B C as L
  by_cases between A B C
  · euclid_apply coll_angles_eq A B C D
    euclid_finish
  · by_cases between A C B
    · euclid_apply coll_angles_eq A C B D
      euclid_finish
    · euclid_apply coll_angles_eq C A B D
      euclid_finish

name: between_imp_angles_sum
statement: theorem between_imp_angles_sum : ∀(A B C D: Point), between B C D ∧ (¬ Coll A B C) → ∠D:A:C + ∠C:A:B = ∠D:A:B

:= by

name: between_if_angles_sum
statement: theorem between_if_angles_sum: ∀ (A B C D: Point), (Triangle A B C) ∧ (Coll B D C) ∧ (∠D:A:C = ∠D:A:B) → between B D C
proof:
:= by
  euclid_intros
  euclid_apply line_from_points
  euclid_assert D ≠ A
  have : D ≠ B := by
    by_contra
    euclid_apply coincident_angle_eq_zero D A
    euclid_assert ∠B:A:C = 0
    euclid_finish
  have : D ≠ C := by
    by_contra
    euclid_apply coincident_angle_eq_zero D A
    euclid_finish
  have : ¬ (between D C B) := by
    by_contra
    euclid_apply between_imp_angles_sum A B C D
    euclid_finish
  have : ¬ (between C B D) := by
    by_contra
    euclid_apply between_imp_angles_sum A C B D
    euclid_finish
  euclid_finish

name: eq_opposite_angles
statement: theorem eq_opposite_angles : ∀ (A B C D E: Point), between A C E ∧ between B C D → ∠A:C:B = ∠ D:C:E
proof:
:= by
  euclid_intros
  by_cases Coll A B C
  · euclid_apply line_from_points
    euclid_finish
  · euclid_apply line_from_points
    euclid_apply coll_angles_eq
    euclid_finish

name: triangle_angles_sum
statement: theorem triangle_angles_sum : ∀(A B C : Point) , Triangle A B C → ∠A:B:C +∠B:C:A + ∠C:A:B = ∟ + ∟
proof:
:= by
  euclid_intros
  euclid_apply line_from_points
  euclid_apply line_from_points A B as AB
  euclid_apply line_from_points B C as BC
  euclid_apply line_from_points C A as CA
  euclid_apply extend_point BC B C as D
  euclid_apply proposition_32 A B C D AB BC CA
  euclid_finish

name: completeQuadrilateral_angles_sum
statement: theorem completeQuadrilateral_angles_sum : ∀ (A B C D E F: Point) (ABC CDF BDE AEF : Line), CompleteQuadrilateral A B C D E F ABC CDF BDE AEF → ∠E:A:C + ∠A:E:D + ∠A:C:D = ∠E:D:C
proof:
:= by
  euclid_intros
  euclid_apply triangle_angles_sum A B E
  euclid_apply triangle_angles_sum B D C
  euclid_apply coll_supp_angles C B D E
  euclid_apply coll_supp_angles E A B C

name: acuteAngle_foot_eq_angles
statement: theorem acuteAngle_foot_eq_angles : ∀ (A B C D : Point) (BC: Line), distinctPointsOnLine B C BC ∧ ¬ (A.onLine BC) ∧ Foot A D BC ∧ ∠A:B:C < ∟ → ∠A:B:C = ∠A:B:D

name: perpBisector_imp_opposingSides
statement:
theorem perpBisector_imp_opposingSides:  ∀ (A B : Point) (L : Line),
PerpBisector A B L → A.opposingSides B L
proof:
:= by
  euclid_intros
  euclid_apply exists_midpoint A B as M
  euclid_apply line_nonempty L as X1
  euclid_apply exists_distincts_points_on_line L X1 as X2
  euclid_apply line_from_points X1 A as X1A
  euclid_apply line_from_points X1 B as X1B
  euclid_apply line_from_points X2 A as X2A
  euclid_apply line_from_points X2 B as X2B
  have h1: ¬ A.sameSide B L := by
    by_contra
    euclid_apply proposition_7 X1 X2 A B L X1A X2A X1B X2B
    euclid_finish
  euclid_finish

name: perpBisector_imp_eq_dist
statement:
theorem perpBisector_imp_eq_dist : ∀ (A B : Point) (L : Line),
  PerpBisector A B L →
  (∀ (X : Point), X.onLine L → |(X─A)| = |(X─B)|) ∧
  (∀ (X : Point), |(X─A)| = |(X─B)| → X.onLine L)
proof:
:= by
  euclid_intros
  euclid_apply perpBisector_imp_opposingSides A B L
  constructor
  · euclid_finish
  · euclid_intros
    by_contra
    by_cases X.sameSide B L
    · euclid_apply line_from_points X A as XA
      euclid_assert XA.intersectsLine L
      obtain ⟨Y, hY⟩ := intersection_lines XA L  (by euclid_finish)
      euclid_assert Triangle Y X B
      euclid_apply triangle_inequality X B Y
      have h1: |(X─Y)| + |(Y─A)| = |(X─A)| := by
        euclid_finish
      euclid_finish
    · euclid_assert X.sameSide A L
      euclid_apply line_from_points X B as XB
      euclid_assert XB.intersectsLine L
      obtain ⟨Y, hY⟩ := intersection_lines XB L  (by euclid_finish)
      euclid_assert Triangle Y X A
      euclid_apply triangle_inequality X A Y
      have h1: |(X─Y)| + |(Y─B)| = |(X─B)| := by
        euclid_finish
      euclid_finish

name: perpBisector_if_eq_dist
statement:
theorem perpBisector_if_eq_dist :
∀ (a b p q : Point) (L : Line),
(a ≠ b) ∧ (|(a─p)| = |(b─p)|) ∧ (|(a─q)| = |(b─q)|) ∧ distinctPointsOnLine p q L
→ PerpBisector a b L
proof:
:= by
  euclid_intros
  simp
  constructor
  · euclid_finish
  · intro x hx
    by_cases (¬ a.onLine L ∧ ¬ b.onLine L)
    · by_cases (x ≠ p ∧ x ≠ q)
      · have h1: ∠x:p:a = ∠x:p:b := by
          have h2: ∠ q:p:a = ∠q:p:b := by
            euclid_apply congruentTriangles_SSS q p a q p b
            euclid_finish
          euclid_apply coll_angles_eq
          euclid_finish
        euclid_apply congruentTriangles_SAS x p a x p b
        euclid_finish
      · euclid_finish
    · by_cases a.onLine L
      · have h : Coll a p q := by
          euclid_finish
        rcases h with h1|h2|h3|h4|h5
        · euclid_apply triangle_inequality b q p
          euclid_finish
        · euclid_apply triangle_inequality b p q
          euclid_finish
        · euclid_apply triangle_inequality p q b
          euclid_finish
        · euclid_finish
        · euclid_finish
      · have h : Coll b p q := by
          euclid_finish
        rcases h with h1|h2|h3|h4|h5
        · euclid_apply triangle_inequality a q p
          euclid_finish
        · euclid_apply triangle_inequality a p q
          euclid_finish
        · euclid_apply triangle_inequality p q a
          euclid_finish
        · euclid_finish
        · euclid_finish

name: perpBisector_iff
statement:
theorem perpBisector_iff : ∀ (A B : Point) (L: Line),
PerpBisector A B L ↔ ∃ (P :Point) (AB : Line), P.onLine L ∧ MidPoint A P B ∧ PerpLine AB L ∧ distinctPointsOnLine A B AB
proof:
:= by
  euclid_intros
  constructor
  · intro h
    euclid_apply exists_midpoint A B as P
    euclid_apply line_from_points A B as AB
    euclid_apply perpBisector_imp_eq_dist A B L
    use P
    use AB
    have h1: PerpLine AB L := by
      use P
      constructor
      · euclid_finish
      · intro X Y h11
        euclid_apply congruentTriangles_SSS P Y A P Y B
        euclid_finish
    euclid_finish
  · intro h
    simp
    constructor
    · euclid_finish
    · intro x hx
      rcases h with ⟨P, AB, hx⟩
      by_cases x = P
      · euclid_finish
      · euclid_assert RightTriangle P x A
        euclid_apply congruentTriangles_SAS x P A x P B
        euclid_finish

name: perpBisector_imp_perpLine
statement: theorem perpBisector_imp_perpLine : ∀(A B: Point) (AB L: Line), distinctPointsOnLine A B AB ∧  (PerpBisector A B L) → PerpLine AB L
proof:
:= by
  euclid_intros
  euclid_apply (perpBisector_iff A B L).mp as (P,L2)
  euclid_finish

name: perpBisector_imp_congruentTriangles
statement: theorem perpBisector_imp_congruentTriangles : ∀ (A B P Q : Point) (L: Line), PerpBisector A B L ∧ P.onLine L ∧ Q.onLine L ∧ P ≠ Q → CongruentTriangles P Q A P Q B
proof:
:= by
  euclid_intros
  euclid_apply line_from_points P Q as PQ
  euclid_apply exists_midpoint A B as C
  have h_0 : C.onLine PQ := by
    euclid_apply perpBisector_iff A B L
    euclid_finish
  euclid_apply congruentTriangles_SSS P Q A P Q B
  euclid_finish

name: parallel_imp_eq_alternateAngles
statement:
theorem parallel_imp_eq_alternateAngles :
∀ (L M T : Line) (A B C D : Point),
  (¬ L.intersectsLine M) ∧
  TwoLinesIntersectAtPoint L T A ∧
  TwoLinesIntersectAtPoint M T B ∧
  C.onLine L ∧
  D.onLine M ∧ A ≠ C ∧ D ≠ B ∧ A ≠ B ∧
  C.opposingSides D T
  → ∠ C:A:B = ∠ D:B:A
proof:
:= by
  euclid_intros
  obtain ⟨C', hC'1, hC'2⟩ := extend_point L C A (by euclid_finish)
  have : A ≠ B := by tauto
  obtain ⟨A', hA'⟩ := extend_point T B A (by euclid_finish)
  obtain ⟨D', hD'⟩ := extend_point M D B (by euclid_finish)
  obtain ⟨B', hB'⟩ := extend_point T A B (by euclid_finish)
  have := proposition_29 C C' D' D A' B' A B  L M T (by euclid_finish)
  euclid_finish

name: parallel_if_eq_alternateAngles
statement:
theorem parallel_if_eq_alternateAngles :
∀ (L M T : Line) (A B C D : Point),
  TwoLinesIntersectAtPoint L T A ∧
  TwoLinesIntersectAtPoint M T B ∧
  C.onLine L ∧
  D.onLine M ∧
  C.opposingSides D T ∧ A ≠ B
  ∧ ∠ C:A:B = ∠ A:B:D  → (¬ L.intersectsLine M)
proof:
:= by
  euclid_intros
  obtain ⟨c', hc'⟩ := extend_point L C A (by euclid_finish)
  obtain ⟨d', hd'⟩ := extend_point M D B (by euclid_finish)
  obtain ⟨a', ha'⟩ := extend_point T B A (by euclid_finish)
  obtain ⟨b', hb'⟩ := extend_point T A B (by euclid_finish)
  have h1: ∠a':A :c' = ∠C:A:B := by
    euclid_apply eq_opposite_angles C B A a' c'
    euclid_finish
  have := proposition_28 C c' d' D a' b' A B L M T (by euclid_finish)
  euclid_finish

name: parallel_if_eq_alternateExteriorAngles
statement:
theorem parallel_if_eq_alternateExteriorAngles : ∀ (a b c d e : Point) (AB CD BD : Line),
  distinctPointsOnLine a b AB ∧ distinctPointsOnLine c d CD ∧ distinctPointsOnLine b d BD ∧
  (between e b d) ∧ (a.sameSide c BD) ∧
  (∠ e:b:a = ∠ e:d:c) →
  ¬(AB.intersectsLine CD)

name: parallel_imp_eq_alternateExteriorAngles
statement:
theorem parallel_imp_eq_alternateExteriorAngles : ∀ (a b c d e : Point) (AB CD BD : Line),
  distinctPointsOnLine a b AB ∧ distinctPointsOnLine c d CD ∧ distinctPointsOnLine b d BD ∧
  (between e b d) ∧ (a.sameSide c BD) ∧
  ¬(AB.intersectsLine CD)  → (∠ e:b:a = ∠ e:d:c)
proof:
:= by
  euclid_intros
  obtain ⟨d', hd'⟩ := extend_point BD b d (by euclid_finish)
  obtain ⟨c', hc'⟩ := extend_point CD c d (by euclid_finish)
  obtain ⟨a', ha'⟩ := extend_point AB a b (by euclid_finish)
  have := proposition_29 a' a c' c e d' b d AB CD BD (by euclid_finish)
  euclid_finish

name: parallel_imp_supp_consecutiveAngles
statement:
theorem parallel_imp_supp_consecutiveAngles :
∀ (L M T : Line) (A B C D : Point),
  (¬ L.intersectsLine M) ∧
  TwoLinesIntersectAtPoint L T A ∧
  TwoLinesIntersectAtPoint M T B ∧
  C.onLine L ∧
  D.onLine M ∧
  C.sameSide D T ∧ A ≠ B
  → ∠ C:A:B + ∠ A:B:D = ∟ + ∟
proof:
:= by
  euclid_intros
  obtain ⟨c', hc'⟩ := extend_point L C A (by euclid_finish)
  obtain ⟨d', hd'⟩ := extend_point M D B (by euclid_finish)
  obtain ⟨a', ha'⟩ := extend_point T B A (by euclid_finish)
  obtain ⟨b', hb'⟩ := extend_point T A B (by euclid_finish)
  have := proposition_29 c' C d' D a' b' A B L M T (by euclid_finish)
  euclid_finish

name: parallel_if_supp_consecutiveAngles
statement:
theorem parallel_if_supp_consecutiveAngles :
∀ (L M T : Line) (A B C D : Point),
  TwoLinesIntersectAtPoint L T A ∧
  TwoLinesIntersectAtPoint M T B ∧
  C.onLine L ∧
  D.onLine M ∧
  C.sameSide D T ∧ A ≠ B
  ∧ ∠ C:A:B + ∠ A:B:D = ∟ + ∟ → (¬ L.intersectsLine M)
proof:
:= by
  euclid_intros
  obtain ⟨c', hc'⟩ := extend_point L C A (by euclid_finish)
  obtain ⟨d', hd'⟩ := extend_point M D B (by euclid_finish)
  obtain ⟨a', ha'⟩ := extend_point T B A (by euclid_finish)
  obtain ⟨b', hb'⟩ := extend_point T A B (by euclid_finish)
  have := proposition_28 c' C d' D a' b' A B L M T (by euclid_finish)
  euclid_finish

name: common_perpLine_imp_coll
statement: theorem common_perpLine_imp_coll : ∀ (A B C D: Point), A ≠ B ∧ C ≠ B  ∧ B ≠ D ∧  ∠A:B:C = ∟ ∧ ∠A:B:D = ∟ → Coll B C D
proof:
:= by
  euclid_intros
  euclid_apply line_from_points A B as AB
  by_cases C.sameSide D AB
  · euclid_apply coll_if_eq_angles A B C D AB
    euclid_finish
  · euclid_assert ¬ C.onLine AB
    euclid_apply coll_if_supp_angles A B C D AB
    euclid_finish

name: perpLine_imp_rightAngleLine_parallel
statement:
theorem perpLine_imp_rightAngleLine_parallel : ∀ (L1 L2 M : Line),
  (PerpLine L1 M) ∧ (PerpLine L2 M) ∧ L1 ≠ L2 →
  ¬(L1.intersectsLine L2)
proof:
:= by
    euclid_intros
    euclid_apply intersection_lines L1 M as P
    euclid_apply intersection_lines L2 M as Q
    have h1: P ≠ Q := by
      by_contra
      euclid_apply exists_distincts_points_on_line L1 P as R
      euclid_apply exists_distincts_points_on_line L2 P as S
      euclid_apply exists_distincts_points_on_line M P as T
      euclid_assert ∠R:P:T = ∟
      euclid_assert ∠S:P:T = ∟
      have h1: Coll T P S := by
        euclid_apply common_perpLine_imp_coll T P R S
        euclid_finish
      euclid_finish
    simp_all
    euclid_apply exists_distincts_points_on_line L1 P as R
    euclid_apply exists_distincts_points_on_line L2 Q as T
    euclid_assert ∠ R:P:Q = ∟
    by_cases R.sameSide T M
    · euclid_apply parallel_if_supp_consecutiveAngles
      euclid_finish
    · euclid_apply parallel_if_eq_alternateAngles
      euclid_finish

statement:
theorem perp_parallel_imp_perp:
  ∀ (M N L : Line),

name: angleBisector_opposingSides
statement: theorem angleBisector_opposingSides : ∀ (A B C I : Point) (AI : Line), (distinctPointsOnLine A I AI) ∧ Triangle A B C ∧ ∠ I:A:B = ∠ I:A:C →  B.opposingSides C AI

name: acuteAngle_foot_on_ray
statement: theorem acuteAngle_foot_on_ray : ∀(A B C D: Point) (BC: Line), distinctPointsOnLine B C BC ∧ Foot A D BC ∧ ∠A:B:C < ∟ → LiesOnRay B C D
proof:
:= by

name: obutseAngle_foot_on_ray

name: triangle_two_altitudes_intersect
statement: theorem triangle_two_altitudes_intersect : ∀ (A B C D E : Point) (AB BC CA AD BE: Line), formTriangle A B C AB BC CA ∧ Foot A D BC ∧ Foot B E CA ∧ distinctPointsOnLine A D AD ∧ distinctPointsOnLine B E BE → AD.intersectsLine BE
proof:
:= by
  euclid_intros
  by_contra
  euclid_assert PerpLine AD BC
  euclid_apply perp_parallel_imp_perp AD BC BE
  euclid_apply perp_parallel_imp_perp BE CA AD
  euclid_assert ∠E:B:C = ∟
  by_cases E = C
  · euclid_finish
  · euclid_apply triangle_angles_sum E B C
    euclid_apply triangle_angle_positive E B C
    euclid_finish

name: eq_feet_if_perpLine
statement: theorem eq_feet_if_perpLine: ∀ (A B H : Point) (l : Line), (Foot A H l) ∧ (Coll A B H) ∧ (B ≠ H) → Foot B H l
proof:
:= by

name: triangle_two_feet_eq_pow
statement: theorem triangle_two_feet_eq_pow : ∀ (A B C D E : Point) (AB BC CA: Line), formTriangle A B C AB BC CA ∧ Foot A D BC ∧ Foot B E CA → |(C─D)| * |(C─B)| =|(C─E)| * |(C─A)|
proof:
:=  by
  euclid_intros
  by_cases ∠B:C:A = ∟
  · have h1: (E = C) ∧ (D = C) := by
      euclid_apply foot_unique B C E CA
      euclid_apply foot_unique A C D BC
      euclid_finish
    euclid_finish
  · have h2: ∠ A:C:D = ∠B:C:E := by
      by_cases ∠B:C:A < ∟
      · euclid_apply acuteAngle_foot_eq_angles A C B D BC
        euclid_apply acuteAngle_foot_eq_angles B C A E CA
        euclid_finish
      · have h3: between B C D := by
          euclid_apply obtuseTriangle_foot_between A C B D BC
          euclid_finish
        have h4: between A C E := by
          euclid_apply obtuseTriangle_foot_between B C A E CA
          euclid_finish
        have h5: ∠ A:C:D + ∠A:C:B = ∟ + ∟ := by
          euclid_apply coll_angles_eq
          euclid_finish
        have h6: ∠ B:C:E + ∠B:C:A = ∟ + ∟ := by
          euclid_apply coll_angles_eq
          euclid_finish
        euclid_finish
    euclid_apply similar_AA D C A E C B
    euclid_finish

name: exists_orthocentre
statement: theorem exists_orthocentre: ∀ (A B C D E F: Point) (AB BC CA: Line), formTriangle A B C AB BC CA ∧ Foot A D BC ∧ Foot B E CA ∧ Foot C F AB → ∃ (H : Point), Orthocentre H A B C D E F AB BC CA
proof:
:= by
  euclid_intros
  euclid_apply line_from_points A D as AD
  euclid_apply line_from_points B E as BE
  euclid_apply triangle_two_altitudes_intersect A B C D E AB BC CA AD BE
  euclid_apply intersection_lines AD BE as H
  use H
  have h1: |(A─F)| * |(B─D)| * |(C─E)| = |(B─F)| * |(C─D)| * |(A─E)| := by
    have h11: |(C─D)| * |(C─B)| =|(C─E)| * |(A─C)| := by
      euclid_apply triangle_two_feet_eq_pow A B C D E AB BC CA
      euclid_finish
    have h12: |(A─E)| * |(A─C)| =|(A─F)| * |(B─A)| := by
      euclid_apply triangle_two_feet_eq_pow B C A E F BC CA AB
      euclid_finish
    have h13: |(B─F)| * |(B─A)| =|(B─D)| * |(C─B)| := by
      euclid_apply triangle_two_feet_eq_pow C A B F D CA AB BC
      euclid_finish
    have h14: |(C─D)| * |(C─B)| * (|(A─E)| * |(A─C)|) * (|(B─F)| * |(B─A)|) = |(C─E)| * |(A─C)| * |(A─F)| * |(B─A)| * |(B─D)| * |(C─B)| := by
      rw[h11,h12,h13]
      linarith
    have h15: |(A─F)| * |(B─D)| * |(C─E)| * (|(C─B)| * |(A─C)| * |(B─A)|) = |(B─F)| * |(C─D)| * |(A─E)| * (|(C─B)| * |(A─C)| * |(B─A)|):=  by
      calc
      _ = |(C─D)| * |(C─B)| * (|(A─E)| * |(A─C)|) * (|(B─F)| * |(B─A)|)  := by linarith
      _ = |(C─E)| * |(A─C)| * |(A─F)| * |(B─A)| * |(B─D)| * |(C─B)|  := by rw [h14]
      _ = _ := by linarith
    have h_nonzero: (|(C─B)| * |(A─C)| * |(B─A)|) ≠ 0 := by euclid_finish
    apply (mul_left_inj' h_nonzero).mp
    linarith
  have h2: Coll C H F := by
    euclid_apply CevaTheorem_converse B C A E F D H
    euclid_finish
  euclid_finish

name: orthocentre_of_rightTriangle
statement:
theorem orthocentre_of_rightTriangle:
  ∀ (A B C H D E F : Point) (AB BC CA : Line),

    H = A
proof:
:= by

      euclid_apply foot_unique B A E CA

name: orthocentre_of_acuteTriangle_insideTriangle
statement:
theorem orthocentre_of_acuteTriangle_insideTriangle:
  ∀ (A B C H D E F : Point) (AB BC CA: Line),
    (formAcuteTriangle A B C AB BC CA) ∧ (Orthocentre H A B C D E F AB BC CA)
    → InsideTriangle H A B C AB BC CA
proof:
:= by
  euclid_intros
  
  
  
  

  
  have h_between_BDC : between B D C := by
    euclid_apply acuteTriangle_foot_between A B C D BC
    euclid_finish
  have h_between_AEC : between A E C := by

name: orthocentre_of_acuteTriangle_insideTriangle_transfer
statement: theorem orthocentre_of_acuteTriangle_insideTriangle_transfer : ∀(A B C D E F H: Point) (AB BC CA AH BH: Line), AcuteTriangle A B C ∧  distinctPointsOnLine A H AH ∧ distinctPointsOnLine B H BH ∧ Orthocentre H A B C D E F AB BC CA → Orthocentre C A B H E D F AB BH AH
proof:
:= by

  have h1 : InsideTriangle H A B C AB BC CA := by
    euclid_apply orthocentre_of_acuteTriangle_insideTriangle A B C H D E F AB BC CA

name: acuteTriangle_power_of_orthocenter
statement:
theorem acuteTriangle_power_of_orthocenter :
  ∀ (A B C D E F H : Point) (AB BC CA : Line),
    AcuteTriangle A B C ∧

    → |(A─H)| * |(H─D)| = |(B─H)| * |(H─E)|
proof:

name: exists_circumcentre

name: acuteTriangle_circumcentre_insideTriangle
statement: theorem acuteTriangle_circumcentre_insideTriangle: ∀(A B C O: Point) (AB BC CA : Line),formTriangle A B C AB BC CA ∧ AcuteTriangle A B C ∧ Circumcentre O A B C → InsideTriangle O A B C AB BC CA
proof:
:= by
  euclid_intros
  euclid_apply circle_from_points O A as Ω
  have h1: O.sameSide A BC := by
    by_contra
    by_cases O.opposingSides A BC
    · euclid_apply InscribedAngleTheorem_opposingSides C B A O BC Ω
      euclid_finish
    · euclid_apply ThalesTheorem B C A O Ω
      euclid_finish
  have h1: O.sameSide B CA := by
    by_contra
    by_cases O.opposingSides B CA
    · euclid_apply InscribedAngleTheorem_opposingSides A C B O CA Ω
      euclid_finish
    · euclid_apply ThalesTheorem C A B O Ω
      euclid_finish
  have h1: O.sameSide C AB := by
    by_contra
    by_cases O.opposingSides C AB
    · euclid_apply InscribedAngleTheorem_opposingSides B A C O AB Ω
      euclid_finish
    · euclid_apply ThalesTheorem A B C O Ω
      euclid_finish
  euclid_finish

name: isoTriangle_base_side_cos
statement: theorem isoTriangle_base_side_cos : ∀(A B C : Point), |(A─B)| = |(A─C)| ∧ B ≠ C → 2 * |(A─B)| * cos (∠A:B:C) = |(B─C)|
proof:
:= by
  euclid_intros
  euclid_apply line_from_points A B as AB
  by_cases Coll A B C
  · euclid_assert MidPoint B A C
    have  h1: 2 * |(A─B)| = |(B─C)| := by
      euclid_finish
    have h2: ∠ A:B:C = 0 := by
      euclid_finish
    euclid_apply Real.cos_zero
    euclid_finish
  · euclid_apply exists_midpoint B C as D
    have h1: ∠B:D:A = ∟ := by
      euclid_apply isoTriangle_three_lines_concidence_midpoint A B C D
      euclid_finish
    euclid_apply rightTriangle_cos D B A
    have h3 : ∠D:B:A = ∠A:B:C :=by
      euclid_apply coll_angles_eq
      euclid_finish
    euclid_finish

name: circumcentre_inscribedAngle_comp
statement:
theorem circumcentre_inscribedAngle_comp : ∀ (A B C O : Point) (AB: Line) (Ω : Circle), (distinctPointsOnLine A B AB) ∧ (O.sameSide C AB) ∧ (A.onCircle Ω) ∧ (B.onCircle Ω) ∧ (C.onCircle Ω) ∧ (O.isCentre Ω)
  → ∠ O:B:A +  ∠ A:C:B= ∟
proof:
:= by
  euclid_intros
  euclid_apply InscribedAngleTheorem_sameSide A B C O AB Ω
  euclid_apply isoTriangle_imp_eq_angles O A B
  euclid_apply triangle_angles_sum O A B
  euclid_finish

name: circumcentre_inscribedAngle_diff_rightAngle
statement:
theorem circumcentre_inscribedAngle_diff_rightAngle : ∀ (A B C O : Point) (AB: Line) (Ω : Circle), (distinctPointsOnLine A B AB) ∧ (O.opposingSides C AB) ∧ (A.onCircle Ω) ∧ (B.onCircle Ω) ∧ (C.onCircle Ω) ∧ (O.isCentre Ω)
  → ∠ A:C:B - ∠ O:B:A = ∟
proof:
:= by
  euclid_intros
  euclid_apply InscribedAngleTheorem_opposingSides A B C O AB Ω
  euclid_apply isoTriangle_imp_eq_angles O A B
  euclid_apply triangle_angles_sum O A B
  euclid_finish

name: LawOfSines_radius
statement: theorem LawOfSines_radius: ∀ (A B C O: Point), Triangle A B C ∧ Circumcentre O A B C → |(B─C)| = 2 * Real.sin (∠B:A:C) * |(A─O)|
proof:
:= by
  euclid_intros
  euclid_apply line_from_points B C as BC
  euclid_apply isoTriangle_base_side_cos O B C
  euclid_apply circle_from_points O A as Ω
  by_cases O.sameSide A BC
  · have h1: ∠O:C:B = ∟ - ∠B:A:C := by
      euclid_apply circumcentre_inscribedAngle_comp B C A O BC Ω
      euclid_finish
    have h2: |(B─C)| = 2 * |(A─O)| * cos (∠O:C:B) := by
      euclid_apply isoTriangle_base_side_cos O C B
      euclid_finish
    rw [h2, h1]
    euclid_apply rightAngle_eq_pi_div_two
    euclid_apply Real.cos_pi_div_two_sub (∠B:A:C)
    euclid_finish
  · by_cases O.opposingSides A BC
    · have h1: ∠O:C:B + ∟ =  ∠B:A:C := by
        euclid_apply circumcentre_inscribedAngle_diff_rightAngle B C A O BC Ω
        euclid_finish
      have h2: |(B─C)| = 2 * |(A─O)| * cos (∠O:C:B) := by
        euclid_apply isoTriangle_base_side_cos O C B
        euclid_finish
      rw [h2, ← h1]
      euclid_apply rightAngle_eq_pi_div_two
      euclid_apply Real.sin_add_pi_div_two (∠O:C:B)
      euclid_finish
    · euclid_assert MidPoint B O C
      euclid_apply ThalesTheorem B C A O Ω
      euclid_apply sin_pi_div_two
      euclid_apply rightAngle_eq_pi_div_two
      euclid_finish

name: triangle_angle_positive
statement: theorem triangle_angle_positive : ∀(A B C : Point) , Triangle A B C → ∠A:B:C > 0 ∧ ∠A:C:B > 0 ∧ ∠C:A:B > 0

:= by
